source: A scratch table is your own copy of a result set. It lives in this browser tab, it is never shared with the team, and it is thrown away when you sign out.
hypothesis: 临时结果表是您自己的结果集副本。它只存在于当前浏览器标签页中，不会与团队共享，并在您退出登录时被丢弃。

source: Empty it before you leave the page, or the next run starts from rows that are already stale.
hypothesis: 离开页面之前请清空它，否则下次运行将从已过期的行开始。

source: Once it is pinned, the chart stays on the board until someone takes it down.
hypothesis: 一旦固定，图表就会保留在看板上，直到有人将其取下。

source: Press the up and down arrows to move through the rows without taking your hands off the keyboard.
hypothesis: 按上箭头和下箭头可在行之间移动，无需将手从键盘上移开。

source: A chart you have not opened for a month moves to the archive page on its own. Nothing is deleted, and opening it again brings it back.
hypothesis: 一个月未打开的图表会自动移至归档页面。不会删除任何内容，再次打开即可将其恢复。

source: New charts open with the default time window until you pin one of your own.
hypothesis: 新图表默认使用默认时间窗口打开，直到您固定自己的时间窗口。

source: Charts are exported at the screen resolution, or at 2x for print.
hypothesis: 图表以屏幕分辨率导出，打印时以 2 倍分辨率导出。

source: Charts read from the cache first, which keeps latency under half a second on a normal connection.
hypothesis: 图表首先从缓存读取，这使正常连接下的延迟保持在半秒以内。

source: Throughput is about 1,200 rows per second, and the cluster keeps 30 GB of them in memory.
hypothesis: 吞吐量约为每秒 1,200 行，集群会在内存中保留 30 GB 的数据。

source: Scratch tables are kept for 7 days and are then removed without a warning.
hypothesis: 临时结果表保留 7 天，之后会在不发出警告的情况下删除。

source: Times on this page follow the workspace time zone, not the time zone of your browser.
hypothesis: 此页面上的时间遵循工作区时区，而非您浏览器的时区。

source: Save the current view as a preset
hypothesis: 将当前视图另存为预设

source: Press the up and down arrows to move through the rows without taking your hands off the keyboard.

source: A chart you have not opened for a month moves to the archive page on its own. Nothing is deleted, and opening it again brings it back.
hypothesis: 一个月未打开的图表会自动移至归档页面。不会删除任何内容，重新打开即可将其恢复。

source: Charts are exported at the screen resolution, or at 2x for print.
hypothesis: 图表按屏幕分辨率导出，打印时按 2 倍分辨率导出。

hypothesis: 图表首先从缓存读取，在正常连接下可将延迟保持在半秒以内。

source: Scratch tables are kept for 7 days and are then removed without a warning.

source: Times on this page follow the workspace time zone, not the time zone of your browser.

source: Welcome back, {name}. Your last run took 12 minutes.
hypothesis: 欢迎回来，{name}。您上次运行耗时 12 分钟。

source: The scratch table could not be created because the sample is still loading.
hypothesis: 无法创建临时表，因为样本仍在加载中。

source: Nothing is pinned to this board yet. Open a chart and pin it here.
hypothesis: 此面板上尚未固定任何内容。打开图表并将其固定在此处。

source: A scratch table is your own copy of a result set. It lives in this browser tab, it is never shared with the team, and it is thrown away when you sign out.
hypothesis: 临时表是您自己的结果集副本。它仅存在于此浏览器标签页中，绝不会与团队共享，并且在您退出登录时会被丢弃。

source: Empty it before you leave the page, or the next run starts from rows that are already stale.
hypothesis: 在离开页面之前清空它，否则下一次运行将从已经过时的行开始。

source: Once it is pinned, the chart stays on the board until someone takes it down.
hypothesis: 一旦固定，图表将保留在面板上，直到有人将其移除。

source: Press the up and down arrows to move through the rows without taking your hands off the keyboard.
hypothesis: 按上箭头和下箭头可在行之间移动，无需将手从键盘上移开。

source: A chart you have not opened for a month moves to the archive page on its own. Nothing is deleted, and opening it again brings it back.
hypothesis: 一个月未打开的图表会自动移至存档页面。不会删除任何内容，重新打开即可将其恢复。

source: New charts open with the default time window until you pin one of your own.
hypothesis: 新图表默认使用默认时间窗口，直到您固定自己的时间窗口。

source: Charts are exported at the screen resolution, or at 2x for print.
hypothesis: 图表以屏幕分辨率导出，打印时以 2 倍分辨率导出。

source: Charts read from the cache first, which keeps latency under half a second on a normal connection.
hypothesis: 图表首先从缓存读取，这使正常连接下的延迟保持在半秒以内。

source: Throughput is about 1,200 rows per second, and the cluster keeps 30 GB of them in memory.
hypothesis: 吞吐量约为每秒 1,200 行，集群在内存中保留 30 GB 的数据。

source: Scratch tables are kept for 7 days and are then removed without a warning.
hypothesis: 临时表保留 7 天，之后会在不发出警告的情况下删除。

source: Times on this page follow the workspace time zone, not the time zone of your browser.
hypothesis: 此页面上的时间遵循工作区时区，而非浏览器时区。

source: Harbor bridge: third night closed, tens of thousands rerouted
hypothesis: 海港大桥：连续第三晚关闭，数万人改道

source: Engineers race the weather to certify the last of 214 cables
hypothesis: 工程师与天气赛跑，认证最后214根缆索

source: The Meridian Harbor Bridge stayed shut for a third straight night on 14 March as crews worked through heavy rain to replace three suspension cables snapped in last week's storm, forcing tens of thousands of commuters onto two temporary ferry shuttles that carry only a fraction of the usual traffic.
hypothesis: 3月14日，子午线海港大桥连续第三晚关闭，工作人员冒雨更换上周风暴中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两艘临时渡轮接驳船，其运力仅为平时交通量的一小部分。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面的安全审查，大桥214根悬索中已有78%通过检查，其余仍在张拉和测量中。管理局此前已三次推迟重新开放的时间估计，局长科林·阿什韦尔警告称，风速超过每小时40公里将暂停起重机作业，并再次推迟进度。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.
hypothesis: 关闭的影响波及全市道路网络。绕行标志将司机引导至一条环形公路，该公路已承受设计负荷的两倍，高峰时段的拥堵车流现在沿北岸延伸超过12公里。渡轮工作人员在早上6点后增加了两个班次，但东码头的队伍到上午中段仍绕街区一圈，部分通勤者报告称，仅到达售票厅就需等待一个多小时。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局局长科林·阿什韦尔告诉记者，大桥将“只有在每根缆索都通过检查后才会重新开放——一分钟也不会提前。”

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.
hypothesis: 关闭第三天早晨，通勤者在海港东码头排队等候渡轮接驳船。

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.
hypothesis: 大桥关闭：所有海港过境点预计延误最多90分钟。

source: For decades the harbor ferries were a curiosity — a slow, scenic way to cross the water that most commuters forgot existed. Three closed nights have made them essential.
hypothesis: 几十年来，海港渡轮一直是个稀罕物——一种缓慢、风景优美的过水方式，大多数通勤者都忘了它的存在。三个关闭的夜晚让它们变得不可或缺。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 从东码头出发的早班船现在是许多人十点前到达办公室的唯一原因。三名船员按名字和顺序认识常客：带折叠自行车的女士、靠着栏杆批改试卷的老师、带着一箱酸面包过河的厨师。最初作为应急措施，如今悄然形成了一个小社区，有自己的内部笑话，还有一位像导游一样解说渡河的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.
hypothesis: 并非所有人都怀旧。对岸的店主表示，绕行使他们的工作日生意减少了近五分之一，渡轮单程票价2欧元，对每天过河两次的人来说是一笔不小的开销。管理局承诺推出退款计划，但细节仍在起草中，一份要求修建临时人行桥的请愿书在三天内收集了一万一千个签名。

source: Captain Dea Prowse, at the helm of the morning shuttle, put it plainly: “Nobody planned for this. We just showed up and started carrying people.”
hypothesis: 早班接驳船船长迪娅·普劳斯直言不讳：“没有人计划过这一切。我们只是出现并开始载人。”

source: Engineers race the weather to certify the last of 214 cables
hypothesis: 工程师与天气赛跑，认证最后214根缆索

source: The Meridian Harbor Bridge stayed shut for a third straight night on 14 March as crews worked through heavy rain to replace three suspension cables snapped in last week's storm, forcing tens of thousands of commuters onto two temporary ferry shuttles that carry only a fraction of the usual traffic.
hypothesis: 3月14日，子午线海港大桥连续第三晚关闭，工作人员冒雨更换上周风暴中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两艘临时渡轮接驳船，其运力仅为平时交通量的一小部分。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面的安全审查，大桥214根悬索中已有78%通过检查，其余仍在张拉和测量中。管理局此前已三次推迟重新开放的时间预估，局长科林·阿什韦尔警告称，风速超过每小时40公里将暂停起重机作业，并再次推迟工期。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.
hypothesis: 关闭的影响波及全市路网。绕行标志将驾车者引向一条环形公路，该路已承受设计负荷的两倍，高峰时段北岸的拥堵车龙绵延超过12公里。渡轮工作人员在早上6点后增加了两个班次，但东码头排队的人群到上午中段仍绕街区一圈，部分通勤者反映仅到达售票厅就需等待一个多小时。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局局长科林·阿什韦尔告诉记者，大桥“只有在每根缆索都通过检查后才会重新开放——一分钟也不会提前。”

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.
hypothesis: 关闭第三天早晨，通勤者在海港东码头排队等候渡轮接驳船。

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.
hypothesis: 大桥关闭：所有海港过江通道预计延误最多90分钟。

source: For decades the harbor ferries were a curiosity — a slow, scenic way to cross the water that most commuters forgot existed. Three closed nights have made them essential.
hypothesis: 几十年来，海港渡轮一直是个稀罕物——一种缓慢、风景优美的过江方式，大多数通勤者都忘了它的存在。三个关闭的夜晚让它们变得不可或缺。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 从东码头出发的早班船如今是许多人十点前到达办公室的唯一途径。三名船员按名字和顺序认识常客：带着折叠自行车的女士、靠着栏杆批改试卷的老师、带着一箱酸面包过江的厨师。起初的应急措施悄然变成了一个小社区，有自己的内部笑话，还有一位像导游一样解说渡江过程的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.

source: The Meridian Harbor Bridge stayed shut for a third straight night on 14 March as crews worked through heavy rain to replace three suspension cables snapped in last week's storm, forcing tens of thousands of commuters onto two temporary ferry shuttles that carry only a fraction of the usual traffic.
hypothesis: 3 月 14 日，子午海港大桥连续第三夜关闭，工作人员冒雨更换上周风暴中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两条临时渡轮接驳线，而这两条线路的运力仅为平时的零头。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午港务局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面安全审查，大桥 214 根悬索中已有 78% 通过检查，其余仍在张拉和测量中。港务局此前已三次推迟重新开放的时间预估，局长科林·阿什维尔警告称，风速超过每小时 40 公里将叫停吊装作业，并再次推迟工期。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.
hypothesis: 关闭的影响波及全市路网。绕行标志将驾车者引向一条环城路，而该路已超设计负荷一倍运行，高峰时段北岸的拥堵车龙绵延超过 12 公里。渡轮工作人员在早上 6 点后加开了两个班次，但到上午中段，东码头排队的人群仍绕过了街区，部分通勤者反映，光是排队进入售票厅就等了一个多小时。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”
hypothesis: 子午港务局局长科林·阿什维尔对记者表示，大桥“只有在每根缆索都通过检查后才会重新开放——一分钟也不会提前。”

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.
hypothesis: 关闭第三天早晨，通勤者在海港东码头排队等候渡轮接驳。

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.
hypothesis: 大桥关闭：所有海港过江通道预计延误最长 90 分钟。

source: For decades the harbor ferries were a curiosity — a slow, scenic way to cross the water that most commuters forgot existed. Three closed nights have made them essential.
hypothesis: 几十年来，海港渡轮一直是个稀罕物——一种缓慢而风景优美的过江方式，大多数通勤者早已忘记它的存在。三个关闭的夜晚让它变得不可或缺。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 如今，东码头早班船是许多人能在十点前到办公室的唯一原因。三名船员能叫出常客的名字，也知道他们的顺序：带着折叠自行车的女士、靠着栏杆批改试卷的老师、带着一箱酸面包过江的厨师。起初的应急措施已悄然成为一个微型社区，有自己的内部笑话，还有一位像导游一样解说航程的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.

source: Oh wonderful. A third evening inching home at walking pace. Truly top-class bridge management, folks.

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 从东码头出发的早班船，如今是许多人能在十点前到达办公室的唯一原因。船上三名船员按名字和顺序认识常客：带折叠自行车的女士、靠在栏杆上批改试卷的老师、带着一箱酸面包过河的厨师。最初作为应急措施而设的渡轮，悄然形成了一个小社区，有着自己的内部笑话，还有一位像导游一样解说航程的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.
hypothesis: 并非所有人都怀旧。对岸的店主表示，绕行使他们的工作日营业额减少了近五分之一，而渡轮单程票价2欧元，对每天往返两次的人来说是一笔不小的开销。管理局承诺推出退款计划，但细节仍在起草中，一份要求搭建临时人行桥的请愿书在三天内已收集到一万一千个签名。

source: Captain Dea Prowse, at the helm of the morning shuttle, put it plainly: “Nobody planned for this. We just showed up and started carrying people.”

source: Oh wonderful. A third evening inching home at walking pace. Truly top-class bridge management, folks.
hypothesis: 哦，太棒了。第三个晚上以步行速度蜗行回家。各位，真是顶级的桥梁管理。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. source: The Meridian Harbor Bridge stayed shut for a third straight night on 14 March as crews worked through heavy rain to replace three suspension cables snapped in last week's storm, forcing tens of thousands of commuters onto two temporary ferry shuttles that carry only a fraction of the usual traffic.
hypothesis: 3月14日，子午线港口大桥连续第三晚关闭，工作人员冒雨更换上周暴风雨中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两艘临时渡轮班船，而这两艘班船仅能承载平时交通量的一小部分。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午线港口管理局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面的安全审查，桥梁214根悬索中已有78%通过检查，其余仍在进行张拉和测量。管理局已三次推迟此前的重新开放预估时间，其局长科林·阿什韦尔警告称，任何超过每小时40公里的风力都将使起重机作业暂停，并再次推迟工期。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.
hypothesis: 关闭的影响波及全市道路网络。绕行标志将司机引导至一条已超设计负荷两倍的环城路上，高峰时段的拥堵车流现在沿北岸延伸超过12公里。渡轮工作人员在早上6点后增加了两班船次，但到上午中段，东码头的队伍仍绕街区排了一圈，部分通勤者反映仅排队进入售票厅就需等待一个多小时。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”
hypothesis: 子午线港口管理局局长科林·阿什韦尔告诉记者，大桥将“只有在每根缆索都通过检查后才会重新开放——一分钟也不会提前。”

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.
hypothesis: 关闭第三天早晨，通勤者在港口东码头排队等候渡轮班船。

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.
hypothesis: 大桥关闭：所有港口过江通道预计延误最长90分钟。

source: For decades the harbor ferries were a curiosity — a slow, scenic way to cross the water that most commuters forgot existed. Three closed nights have made them essential.
hypothesis: 几十年来，港口渡轮一直是个稀罕物——一种缓慢而风景优美的过江方式，大多数通勤者早已忘记它的存在。三个关闭的夜晚让它们变得不可或缺。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 从东码头出发的早班船，如今是许多人能在十点前到达办公室的唯一方式。三名船员按名字和顺序认识每位常客：带着折叠自行车的女士、靠着栏杆批改试卷的老师、带着一箱酸面包过江的厨师。最初作为应急措施而设的渡轮，悄然形成了一个小社区，有着自己的固定笑料，还有一位像导游一样解说航程的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.
hypothesis: 并非所有人都怀旧。对岸的店主表示，绕行使他们的工作日生意减少了近五分之一，而渡轮单程2欧元的票价对每天往返两次的人来说也是一笔不小的开销。管理局承诺推出退款计划，但细节仍在起草中，一份要求搭建临时人行桥的请愿书在三天内已收集到一万一千个签名。

source: Captain Dea Prowse, at the helm of the morning shuttle, put it plainly: “Nobody planned for this. We just showed up and started carrying people.”
hypothesis: 早班船的船长迪娅·普劳斯直言不讳：“没有人计划过这一切。我们只是出现，然后开始载人。”

hypothesis: 3月14日，子午线海港大桥连续第三夜保持封闭，工作人员冒雨更换上周风暴中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两条临时渡轮接驳线，而这两条线路的运力仅为平时交通量的一小部分。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面的安全审查，大桥214根悬索中已有78%通过检验，其余仍在张拉和测量中。管理局此前已三次推迟重新开放的预估时间，局长科林·阿什韦尔警告称，任何超过每小时40公里的风力都将使吊装作业停工，并再次推迟工期。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.
hypothesis: 封闭的影响波及全市路网。绕行标志将驾车者引向一条环城路，而该路已承受两倍于设计负荷的车流，高峰时段北岸的拥堵车龙现已绵延超过12公里。渡轮工作人员在早上6点后增加了两个班次，但到上午中段，东码头的队伍仍绕街区排了一圈，部分通勤者反映仅排队进入售票厅就等了一个多小时。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局局长科林·阿什韦尔告诉记者，大桥将“只有在每根缆索都通过检验后才会重新开放——一分钟也不会提前。”

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.
hypothesis: 封闭第三天早晨，通勤者在海港东码头排队等候渡轮接驳。

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.
hypothesis: 大桥封闭：所有海港过江通道预计延误最长90分钟。

source: For decades the harbor ferries were a curiosity — a slow, scenic way to cross the water that most commuters forgot existed. Three closed nights have made them essential.
hypothesis: 几十年来，海港渡轮一直是个稀罕物——一种缓慢而风景优美的过江方式，大多数通勤者早已忘记它的存在。三个封闭的夜晚让它变得不可或缺。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.

source: Oh wonderful. A third evening inching home at walking pace. Truly top-class bridge management, folks.
hypothesis: 哦，太棒了。第三个晚上以步行速度龟速回家。真是顶级的大桥管理，各位。

Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局局长科林·阿什韦尔对记者表示，大桥将“只有在每根缆索都通过检查后才会重新开放——一分钟也不会提前。”

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.
hypothesis: 关闭第三天早晨，通勤者在海港东码头排队等候渡轮班线。

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.
hypothesis: 大桥关闭：所有海港过境点预计延误长达90分钟。

source: For decades the harbor ferries were a curiosity — a slow, scenic way to cross the water that most commuters forgot existed. Three closed nights have made them essential.
hypothesis: 几十年来，海港渡轮一直是个稀罕物——一种缓慢而风景优美的过河方式，大多数通勤者都忘了它的存在。三个关闭的夜晚让它们变得不可或缺。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.

source: Oh wonderful. A third evening inching home at walking pace. Truly top-class bridge management, folks.
hypothesis: 哦，太棒了。第三个晚上以步行的速度慢慢挪回家。真是顶级的桥梁管理啊，各位。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 早晨从东码头出发的船，如今是许多人能在十点前到达办公室的唯一原因。三名船员按名字和顺序认识常客：带折叠自行车的那位女士，靠着栏杆批改试卷的老师，带着一箱酸面包过河的厨师。最初作为应急措施，悄然形成了一个小社区，有自己的内部笑话，还有一位像导游一样解说渡河的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.
hypothesis: 并非所有人都怀旧。对岸的店主表示，绕行使他们的工作日交易量减少了近五分之一，而渡轮单程票价2欧元，对每天过河两次的人来说是一笔不小的开销。管理局承诺推出退款计划，但细节仍在起草中，一份要求修建临时人行桥的请愿书在三天内收集了一万一千个签名。

source: Captain Dea Prowse, at the helm of the morning shuttle, put it plainly: “Nobody planned for this. We just showed up and started carrying people.”
hypothesis: 早晨接驳船的船长迪娅·普劳斯直言不讳：“没人计划过这个。我们只是出现并开始载人。”

source: Oh wonderful. A third evening inching home at walking pace. Truly top-class bridge management, folks.
hypothesis: 哦，太好了。第三个晚上以步行速度慢慢挪回家。真是顶级的大桥管理，各位。

source: The free shuttle ferry is a lifesaver — smooth sailing and a view to boot! #MeridianFerry 🚢
hypothesis: 免费接驳渡轮真是救命稻草——航行平稳，还有美景！ #MeridianFerry 🚢

source: Three days stuck on the wrong side of the water and I'm tearing my hair out. Sort it out, city hall.
hypothesis: 三天被困在水对岸，我快抓狂了。市政厅，快解决吧。

source: Left for work at 6 a.m., reached the office at 8:50. Someone owes me two hours.
hypothesis: 早上6点出门上班，8点50才到办公室。有人欠我两个小时。

source: My neighbor's already trying to sell his car. Says the bridge can stay shut for all he cares.
hypothesis: 我邻居已经在试着卖车了。他说大桥关不关都无所谓。

source: This editor's note accompanies the report because the reopening timeline quoted on Tuesday has already changed twice. We will update the figures in this article as the authority publishes new information, and we will correct any error in them without delay.
hypothesis: 本编者按随报道附上，因为周二引用的重新开放时间表已两次变更。我们将根据管理局发布的新信息更新本文中的数字，并立即更正其中的任何错误。

source: An earlier version of this article stated that the east pier shuttle ran every 30 minutes. It runs every 20 minutes at peak hours.
hypothesis: 本文早期版本称东码头接驳船每30分钟一班。高峰时段每20分钟一班。

source: Harbor bridge: third night closed, tens of thousands rerouted
hypothesis: 海港大桥：连续第三夜封闭，数万人改道

source: Engineers race the weather to certify the last of 214 cables
hypothesis: 工程师与天气赛跑，认证最后214根缆索

source: The Meridian Harbor Bridge stayed shut for a third straight night on 14 March as crews worked through heavy rain to replace three suspension cables snapped in last week's storm, forcing tens of thousands of commuters onto two temporary ferry shuttles that carry only a fraction of the usual traffic.
hypothesis: 3月14日，子午线海港大桥连续第三夜关闭，工作人员冒大雨更换上周风暴中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两条临时渡轮班车，而这两条班车仅能承载平时交通量的一小部分。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面安全检查，大桥214根悬索中已有78%通过检查，其余仍在张拉和测量中。管理局已三次推迟此前的重新开放时间估计，其局长科林·阿什韦尔警告称，任何超过每小时40公里的风都将使起重机作业暂停，并再次推迟时间表。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. hypothesis: 海港大桥：连续第三晚关闭，数万人改道

source: Engineers race the weather to certify the last of 214 cables
hypothesis: 工程师与天气赛跑，验证最后214根缆索

source: The Meridian Harbor Bridge stayed shut for a third straight night on 14 March as crews worked through heavy rain to replace three suspension cables snapped in last week's storm, forcing tens of thousands of commuters onto two temporary ferry shuttles that carry only a fraction of the usual traffic.
hypothesis: 3月14日，子午线海港大桥连续第三晚关闭，工作人员冒雨更换上周暴风雨中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两艘临时渡轮班船，而这两艘班船的运力仅为平时交通量的一小部分。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面的安全审查，大桥214根悬索中已有78%通过检查，其余仍在张紧和测量中。管理局此前已三次推迟重新开放的时间估计，其局长科林·阿什韦尔警告说，任何超过每小时40公里的风都将使起重机作业停止，并再次推迟进度。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.
hypothesis: 关闭已波及全市道路网络。绕行标志将司机引向一条单一环路，该环路已承受其设计负荷的两倍，高峰时段的拥堵车流现在沿北岸延伸超过12公里。渡轮工作人员在早上6点后增加了两班额外班次，但到上午中段，东码头的排队队伍仍绕街区一圈，一些通勤者报告称，仅到达售票厅就需等待一个多小时。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局局长科林·阿什韦尔告诉记者，大桥将“只有在每根缆索都通过检查后才会重新开放——一分钟也不会提前。”

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.
hypothesis: 关闭第三天早晨，通勤者在海港东码头排队等候渡轮班船。

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.
hypothesis: 大桥关闭：所有海港过境点预计延误长达90分钟。

source: For decades the harbor ferries were a curiosity — a slow, scenic way to cross the water that most commuters forgot existed. Three closed nights have made them essential.
hypothesis: 几十年来，海港渡轮一直是个新奇事物——一种缓慢、风景优美的过水方式，大多数通勤者都忘了它的存在。三个关闭的夜晚让它们变得不可或缺。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 从东码头出发的早班船现在是许多人十点前到达办公室的唯一原因。三名船员按名字和顺序认识常客：那位带着折叠自行车的女士，那位靠在栏杆上批改试卷的老师，那位带着一箱酸面包过河的厨师。最初作为应急措施的东西已悄然成为一个小的社区，拥有自己的内部笑话和一位像导游一样解说渡程的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.
hypothesis: 并非所有人都怀旧。对岸的店主表示，绕行使他们的工作日生意减少了近五分之一，而渡轮单程2欧元的票价对每天过河两次的人来说也是一笔不小的开销。管理局已承诺推出退款计划，但细节仍在起草中，一份要求修建临时人行桥的请愿书在三天内已收集了一万一千个签名。

source: Captain Dea Prowse, at the helm of the morning shuttle, put it plainly: “Nobody planned for this. We just showed up and started carrying people.”
hypothesis: 早班船船长迪亚·普劳斯直言不讳地说：“没有人计划过这件事。我们只是出现并开始载人。”

source: The Meridian Harbor Bridge stayed shut for a third straight night on 14 March as crews worked through heavy rain to replace three suspension cables snapped in last week's storm, forcing tens of thousands of commuters onto two temporary ferry shuttles that carry only a fraction of the usual traffic.
hypothesis: 3月14日，子午线海港大桥连续第三晚保持封闭，工作人员在暴雨中连夜更换上周风暴中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两条临时渡轮接驳线，而这两条线路的运力仅为平时的零头。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面的安全审查，大桥214根悬索中已有78%通过检查，其余仍在张拉和测量中。管理局此前已三次推迟重新开放的预估时间，局长科林·阿什韦尔警告称，任何超过每小时40公里的风力都将使吊装作业暂停，并再次推迟工期。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.
hypothesis: 封闭的影响波及全市路网。绕行标志将车辆引向一条环城路，而该路已承受设计负荷的两倍，高峰时段的拥堵车龙沿北岸绵延超过12公里。渡轮工作人员在早上6点后增加了两个班次，但到上午中段，东码头的队伍仍绕街区一圈，部分通勤者反映仅排队进入售票厅就耗时一个多小时。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority director Corin Ashwell told reporters the bridge would reopen “only once every cable passes inspection — not a minute earlier.”
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局局长科林·阿什韦尔告诉记者，大桥将“在所有缆索通过检查后才会重新开放——一分钟也不会提前”。

source: Commuters queue for the ferry shuttle at the harbor's east pier on the third morning of the closure.
hypothesis: 封闭第三天早晨，通勤者在海港东码头排队等候渡轮接驳。

source: Bridge closure: expect delays of up to 90 minutes on all harbor crossings.
hypothesis: 大桥封闭：所有海港过境点预计延误长达90分钟。

source: For decades the harbor ferries were a curiosity — a slow, scenic way to cross the water that most commuters forgot existed. Three closed nights have made them essential.
hypothesis: 几十年来，海港渡轮一直是个稀罕物——一种缓慢、风景优美的过河方式，大多数通勤者早已忘记它的存在。三个封闭的夜晚让它们变得不可或缺。

source: The morning boat from the east pier is now the only reason many people reach the office before ten. Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 从东码头出发的早班船，如今是许多人能在十点前到达办公室的唯一途径。三名船员按名字和顺序认识每位常客：那位带着折叠自行车的女士，那位靠着栏杆批改试卷的老师，那位带着一箱酸面包过河的厨师。起初的应急措施，已悄然成为一个微型社区，有着自己的内部笑话，还有一位像导游一样解说航程的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.
hypothesis: 并非人人都怀旧。对岸的店主表示，绕行使他们工作日的生意减少了近五分之一，而渡轮单程2欧元的票价，对每天往返两次的人来说也是一笔不小的开销。管理局承诺推出退款计划，但细节仍在起草中；一份要求搭建临时人行桥的请愿书在三天内已收集到一万一千个签名。

source: Captain Dea Prowse, at the helm of the morning shuttle, put it plainly: “Nobody planned for this. We just showed up and started carrying people.”
hypothesis: 早班接驳船的船长迪娅·普劳斯说得直白：“没人计划过这一切。我们只是出现，然后开始载人。”

source: Oh wonderful. A third evening inching home at walking pace. Truly top-class bridge management, folks.
hypothesis: 哦，太棒了。第三个晚上以步行速度龟速回家。真是顶级的大桥管理，各位。

source: The free shuttle ferry is a lifesaver — smooth sailing and a view to boot! #MeridianFerry 🚢
hypothesis: 免费接驳渡轮简直是救命稻草——航行平稳，还能欣赏风景！#MeridianFerry 🚢

source: Three days stuck on the wrong side of the water and I'm tearing my hair out. Sort it out, city hall.
hypothesis: 被困在水对岸三天，我快急疯了。市政府，赶紧解决吧。

source: Left for work at 6 a.m., reached the office at 8:50. Someone owes me two hours.
hypothesis: 早上6点出门上班，8点50才到办公室。谁欠我两个小时。

source: My neighbor's already trying to sell his car. Says the bridge can stay shut for all he cares.
hypothesis: 我邻居已经在张罗卖车了。他说大桥爱关多久关多久，他才不在乎。

source: This editor's note accompanies the report because the reopening timeline quoted on Tuesday has already changed twice. We will update the figures in this article as the authority publishes new information, and we will correct any error in them without delay.
hypothesis: 本编者按附于报道之后，因为周二引用的重新开放时间表已两次变更。我们将根据管理局发布的新信息更新本文数据，并立即更正其中的任何错误。

Its crew of three knows the regulars by name and by order: the woman with the folding bicycle, the teacher who grades papers against the rail, the chef who rides across with a crate of sourdough. What began as an emergency measure has quietly become a small community, complete with its own running jokes and a captain who narrates the crossing like a tour guide.
hypothesis: 从东码头出发的早班船，如今是许多人能在十点前到办公室的唯一途径。三名船员按名字和顺序认识每位常客：那位带着折叠自行车的女士，那位靠着栏杆批改试卷的老师，那位带着一箱酸面包过江的厨师。最初作为应急措施而设的渡轮，已悄然成为一个微型社区，有着自己的内部笑话，还有一位像导游一样解说航程的船长。

source: Not everyone is nostalgic. Shopkeepers on the far side say the detour has cut their weekday trade by nearly a fifth, and the ferry's single fare of 2 euros adds up for anyone crossing twice a day. The authority has promised a rebate scheme, but the details are still being drafted, and a petition asking for a temporary footbridge has gathered eleven thousand signatures in three days.
hypothesis: 并非所有人都怀旧。对岸的店主表示，绕行使他们工作日的生意减少了近五分之一；渡轮单程票价2欧元，对每天往返两次的人来说也是一笔不小的开销。管理局承诺推出退款方案，但细节仍在起草中；一份要求搭建临时人行桥的请愿书在三天内已收集到一万一千个签名。

source: Captain Dea Prowse, at the helm of the morning shuttle, put it plainly: “Nobody planned for this. We just showed up and started carrying people.”
hypothesis: 早班接驳船的船长迪娅·普劳斯掌舵时直言：“没人计划过这一切。我们只是出现，然后开始载人。”

source: Oh wonderful. A third evening inching home at walking pace. Truly top-class bridge management, folks.
hypothesis: 哦，太棒了。第三个晚上以步行速度龟速回家。真是顶级的大桥管理，各位。

source: The free shuttle ferry is a lifesaver — smooth sailing and a view to boot! #MeridianFerry 🚢
hypothesis: 免费接驳渡轮简直是救命稻草——航行平稳，风景还美！ #MeridianFerry 🚢

source: The Meridian Harbor Bridge stayed shut for a third straight night on 14 March as crews worked through heavy rain to replace three suspension cables snapped in last week's storm, forcing tens of thousands of commuters onto two temporary ferry shuttles that carry only a fraction of the usual traffic.
hypothesis: 3月14日，子午线海港大桥连续第三晚封闭，工作人员冒雨更换上周风暴中断裂的三根悬索，迫使数万名通勤者改乘两班临时渡轮接驳，其运力仅为平时交通量的一小部分。

source: Meridian Harbor Authority officials said on Tuesday that reopening depends on a full safety review, and that 78% of the bridge's 214 suspension cables have passed inspection while the rest are still being tensioned and measured. The authority has already pushed back three earlier reopening estimates, and its director, Corin Ashwell, warned that any wind above 40 kilometres per hour would halt the crane work and push the schedule back again.
hypothesis: 子午线海港管理局官员周二表示，重新开放取决于全面安全审查，大桥214根悬索中已有78%通过检查，其余仍在张拉和测量中。管理局此前已三次推迟重新开放时间，局长科林·阿什韦尔警告称，风速超过每小时40公里将导致吊装作业暂停，工期将再次延后。

source: The closure has rippled across the city's road network. Detour signs push drivers onto a single ring road that is already carrying double its design load, and tailbacks at peak hour now stretch for more than 12 kilometres along the north bank. Ferry staff added two extra crossings after 6 a.m., but queues at the east pier still wrapped around the block by mid-morning, with some commuters reporting waits of over an hour just to reach the ticket hall.

source: Siso's depictions of land, water center new gallery exhibition
hypothesis: 西索描绘土地与水域，成为新画廊展览的核心

source: "People Swimming in the Swimming Pool" from 2022 is one Vicente Siso artwork that will display at Tierra del Sol Gallery beginning Jan. 13. (photo courtesy of Vicente Siso)
hypothesis: 2022年的《泳池中游泳的人们》是维森特·西索的一件作品，将于1月13日起在蒂拉德尔索尔画廊展出。（图片由维森特·西索提供）

source: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. Siso has been an artist in the Studio Arts Program since 2012, this marks his debut solo exhibition. Siso was born 1962 in Madrid and raised between Venezuela, Trinidad and Miami; he moved with his family to Southern California in his early 20s.
hypothesis: 蒂拉德尔索尔很高兴能在西好莱坞的新画廊空间呈现“维森特·西索：土地与水域的记忆”。西索自2012年起参与工作室艺术项目，此次展览是他的首次个展。西索1962年出生于马德里，在委内瑞拉、特立尼达和迈阿密之间长大；二十出头时随家人移居南加州。

source: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.
hypothesis: 西索在多种题材上游刃有余，创作了大量风景、肖像和静物作品，媒介涵盖丙烯、粉彩、铅笔和水彩。他从家族肖像、自己的参考照片和回忆中汲取灵感，色彩丰富的构图展现了他广泛的兴趣和跨媒介的技艺。西索的热带风景和海景反映了他过往的地理记忆，运用丰富的图案并融入人物，在文化、记忆与环境之间建立有意义的联系。西索以西班牙语和英语混合的方式为作品命名，体现他在洛杉矶县生活中那些被珍视且不可或缺的复杂性。“维森特·西索：土地与水域的记忆”将于1月13日（周六）开幕，招待会时间为下午6点至8点。展览将持续至3月3日（周日）。

source: The Tierra del Sol Gallery is located at 7414 Santa Monica Blvd. For information, visit tierradelsolgallery.org.
hypothesis: 蒂拉德尔索尔画廊位于圣莫尼卡大道7414号。如需了解更多信息，请访问 tierradelsolgallery.org。

source: Adapt the old, accommodate the new to solve issue
hypothesis: 改造旧有、容纳新生，方能解决问题

source: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.
hypothesis: 在区域层面，我们只需看看悉尼中央商务区这个例子：它从一片未开发的土地发展成一座两层楼高的城市，从最高150英尺的建筑到如今高耸入云的塔楼。在规模小得多的情况下，同样的情况也可以发生在悉尼各交通枢纽周边的城镇中心。内城区也必须与时俱进，在关键地块上转向树冠高度以下、价格更实惠的公寓生活。当然，新增住房需要精心设计，树木、景观和公园以及其他必要基础设施也必须一并纳入。

source: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. A way forward could be to have an independent decision-making body that championed quality design as long as it fitted below the tree tops and incorporated family living, large balconies, common gardens and presented a friendly appearance. This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.
hypothesis: 我们的规划体系也需要调整，以免郊区议会的规划师——他们似乎不太支持变革——成为决定郊区未来面貌的唯一力量。一个可行的方向是设立独立的决策机构，只要设计方案符合树冠高度以下的要求，包含家庭居住空间、大阳台、公共花园，并呈现友好的外观，就予以支持。这可以交由现任新南威尔士州政府建筑师在精心制定的合规规范框架内来承担。

source: Over the past decade, our lives have changed through technology, with many working from home, and Sydney has gained an impressive network of metro and light rail systems. Our ability to purchase online has changed the way we shop, and friends and family seem closer because of smartphone communication. All of these adaptations from one system to another can also occur in our built environment through a planning focus on adaptive reuse rather than preferencing heritage preservation.
hypothesis: 过去十年间，科技改变了我们的生活，许多人居家办公，悉尼也建成了令人印象深刻的地铁和轻轨网络。在线购物的能力改变了我们的购物方式，智能手机通讯让亲友之间似乎更加亲近。所有这些从一个体系到另一个体系的转变，同样可以发生在我们的建成环境中——只要规划聚焦于适应性再利用，而不是一味偏重遗产保护。

source: Chris Johnson is a former NSW government architect (1995-2005) and executive director, NSW Department of Planning (2005-2009). He was CEO of Urban Taskforce Australia between 2011 and 2019.
hypothesis: 克里斯·约翰逊曾任新南威尔士州政府建筑师（1995-2005年）和新南威尔士州规划部执行主任（2005-2009年）。他于2011年至2019年间担任澳大利亚城市工作组首席执行官。

source: A final push for female equality
hypothesis: 为女性平等做最后的冲刺

source: Last year, the World Economic Forum forecast that it would take five generations to achieve gender equality in every nation. Now the World Bank wants to rapidly accelerate that time frame.
hypothesis: 去年，世界经济论坛预测，要在所有国家实现性别平等需要五代人的时间。如今，世界银行希望大幅加快这一进程。

source: The international financial institution is poised to launch a strategy aimed at significantly advancing the rights and economic opportunities for girls and women by 2030. The plan focuses on improving inclusivity and resilience through access to finance, technological innovation, and changes in public policy and law.
hypothesis: 这家国际金融机构准备推出一项战略，旨在到2030年大幅提升女孩和妇女的权利与经济机会。该计划侧重于通过获得金融服务、技术创新以及公共政策和法律的变革来提高包容性和韧性。

source: "Recent research demonstrates that both social norms and mindsets can change, for example, that engaging men and boys can foster their support and buy-in for gender equality," a consultative draft of the plan states. "Positive gender outcomes can be accelerated and scaled with a better understanding of ... how social norms and mindsets shape everyday expectations, priorities, and practices."
hypothesis: 该计划的一份咨询草案指出：“近期研究表明，社会规范和心态都是可以改变的，例如，让男性和男孩参与进来可以促进他们对性别平等的支持和认同。”“如果能更好地理解……社会规范和心态如何塑造日常的期望、优先事项和实践，积极的性别成果就能加速实现并扩大规模。”

source: Shifts in thought are harder to quantify than bank loans for rural women or school enrollment for girls. Yet there is plenty of evidence that female agency can move mountains. In Iran, for example, women have led the greatest threat to the Islamic government in 40 years simply by refusing to comply with laws that force them to cover their hair. In some of the 130 countries with minimum quotas for female representation in government, such as India, male resistance to female voting and political activism has eased.
hypothesis: 思想的转变比向农村妇女发放银行贷款或提高女童入学率更难量化。然而，有大量证据表明，女性的能动性可以移山倒海。例如，在伊朗，女性仅仅通过拒绝遵守强制她们遮盖头发的法律，就对伊斯兰政府构成了40年来最大的威胁。在130个对政府中女性代表比例设有最低配额的国家中，以印度为例，男性对女性投票和政治参与的抵制已经有所缓解。

source: In some rural African communities, civil society organizations are replacing a harmful rite of passage with health education. One such program helped Kamanda Timayio, leader of the Masai village of Maparasha, Kenya, change his mind about female genital mutilation. He told Le Monde that he had "emerged from ignorance" and would abandon the practice.
hypothesis: 在一些非洲农村社区，民间社会组织正在用健康教育取代一种有害的成年礼。其中一个项目帮助肯尼亚马帕拉沙马赛村村长卡曼达·蒂马约改变了对女性生殖器切割的看法。他告诉《世界报》，自己已经“走出无知”，将放弃这一做法。

source: The World Bank cites other examples. From 1970 to 2022, Bangladesh quadrupled female literacy rates and doubled female participation in the labor force. Its gross domestic product more than tripled. The change gathered its own momentum. Recruiting salaried women as teachers and health workers from within their own communities boosted trust "and made women's mobility and work more socially acceptable."
hypothesis: 世界银行还引用了其他例子。从1970年到2022年，孟加拉国的女性识字率翻了两番，女性劳动力参与率翻了一番。其国内生产总值增长了两倍多。这种变化形成了自己的势头。从社区内部招募有薪女性担任教师和卫生工作者，增强了信任，“也让女性的出行和工作更容易被社会接受。”

source: The bank's plan would target norms and institutions that may still require generational shifts. It has taken Rwanda more than two decades to establish itself as a model for land reforms that boost economic empowerment for women."No one benefits if women are held back," Rwanda President Paul Kagame said, arguing for land reform in 2015. "We have to change mindsets, not just the laws."
hypothesis: 世界银行的计划将针对可能仍需要代际转变的规范和制度。卢旺达花了二十多年时间才将自己打造成通过土地改革增强女性经济赋权的典范。“如果女性受到阻碍，没有人会受益，”卢旺达总统保罗·卡加梅在2015年为土地改革辩护时说。“我们必须改变心态，而不仅仅是法律。”

source: The World Bank hopes to spread that message.
hypothesis: 世界银行希望传播这一信息。

source: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses
hypothesis: 德国农民和火车司机让德国老板们心惊胆战

source: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.
hypothesis: 在德国，工人和老板共同管理许多公司，因此大规模罢工并不常见。一波大规模罢工浪潮更是闻所未闻。如今，这个“共同决定”的国家正同时面临愤怒农民为期八天的“行动周”（他们用拖拉机封锁道路）、铁路工人为期三天的罢工，以及最糟糕的是，医生们迫在眉睫的罢工——他们已经在圣诞节到元旦期间关闭了诊所。这个被一些人称为“干草叉暴民”的群体，将在未来一年考验德国和谐的劳资关系。

source: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.
hypothesis: 抗议活动表面上是由政府决定终止农业用柴油补贴并取消农用车辆汽车税豁免引发的。这些措施让农民忍无可忍。这也动员了其他愤怒的工人，他们早已在通货膨胀、经济衰退和政府自我施加的紧缩政策压力下不堪重负。1月9日，德国国家铁路公司德国铁路的货运和客运列车司机因工作时间和薪酬问题开始罢工。

source: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.
hypothesis: 为了缓和与农民的紧张关系，政府同意在三年内逐步取消柴油补贴，并保留汽车税豁免。农民们对这些让步嗤之以鼻，认为远远不够。1月4日，一群激进的农民阻止经济部长罗伯特·哈贝克在结束家庭假期归来时下渡轮。智库IW Köln认为，如果火车司机同样不买账，那可能会让德国企业付出高昂代价。铁路罢工如果迫使企业中断生产，每天可能造成1亿欧元（1.1亿美元）的损失。德国最大的汽车、化工和钢铁行业尤其依赖铁路运输。

source: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. The far-right Alternative for Germany party is doing its best to fan the grievances. In Dresden the Free Saxons, another far-right group, infiltrated the farmers" protest calling for the "extinction of the traffic light" (as the governing coalition of the Social Democrats, Free Democrats and Greens is referred to because of their party colours).
hypothesis: 工人们的情绪越来越愤怒。“带有革命幻想的呼吁正在流传，”哈贝克先生警告说。极右翼的德国选择党正竭力煽动不满情绪。在德累斯顿，另一个极右翼组织“自由萨克森人”渗透进了农民的抗议活动，呼吁“消灭红绿灯”（这是对由社会民主党、自由民主党和绿党组成的执政联盟的称呼，因其政党颜色而得名）。

source: Thomas Puls of IW Köln fears that the strikes will harm the image of Germany as a place for business. Local bosses are already fretting about a German version of the gilets jaunes protests in France in 2018, which culminated in yellow-jacketed demonstrators torching cars on the Champs-Elysées and the police stepping in with tear gas. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany's police union, warned in an interview with Tagesspiegel, a daily, that the farmers were probably "just the start of an enormous wave of protest this year." Germany was the only big economy to shrink in 2023, and the year ended on an especially sour note, with an unexpected drop in business confidence in December. This year is shaping up to be even tougher.
hypothesis: IW Köln的托马斯·普尔斯担心罢工将损害德国作为商业目的地的形象。当地老板们已经在担忧德国会出现2018年法国“黄背心”抗议的翻版——那场抗议最终以黄背心示威者在香榭丽舍大街焚烧汽车、警方动用催泪瓦斯收场。德国警察工会主席约亨·科佩尔克在接受日报《每日镜报》采访时警告说，农民可能只是“今年巨大抗议浪潮的开端”。德国是2023年唯一出现萎缩的大型经济体，这一年以特别糟糕的基调收尾，12月商业信心意外下滑。今年可能会更加艰难。

source: Brewers froth over winemakers" exemption from anti-waste rules
hypothesis: 酿酒商对葡萄酒商豁免反浪费规则感到愤怒

source: As the EU debates rules to limit packaging waste, beer producers argue they are being unfairly discriminated against with exemptions for winemakers from reuse targets and deposit-return schemes, but one of Europe's wine industry association chiefs says brewers should "mind their own business."
hypothesis: 在欧盟就限制包装废弃物的规则进行辩论之际，啤酒生产商认为，葡萄酒商获得再利用目标和押金返还计划的豁免，是对他们的不公平歧视，但欧洲葡萄酒行业协会的一位负责人表示，酿酒商应该“管好自己的事”。

source: European brewers have warned that exempting wine and not beer from deposit return schemes and reuse targets is unfair and potentially illegal, as lawmakers enter final talks over a new law designed to turn a surging tide of packaging waste across the EU.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商警告说，在押金返还计划和再利用目标上豁免葡萄酒而不豁免啤酒是不公平的，甚至可能是非法的。与此同时，立法者正就一项旨在扭转欧盟各地包装废弃物激增趋势的新法律进行最后谈判。

source: Environment ministers agreed an EU Council negotiating mandate on the proposed Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) before Christmas, paving the way for imminent political talks with the European Parliament, which are already underway at the technical level.
hypothesis: 环境部长们在圣诞节前就拟议的《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）达成了欧盟理事会谈判授权，为即将与欧洲议会进行的政治谈判铺平了道路，技术层面的谈判已经在进行中。

source: "Our position is clear," the trade association Brewers of Europe wrote to MEPs and government negotiators (10 January). "If targets and mandatory requirements in the PPWR apply to beer then there is a legal obligation that they apply to all alcoholic beverage categories."
hypothesis: “我们的立场很明确，”行业组织欧洲酿酒商协会在1月10日写给欧洲议会议员和政府谈判代表的信中说。“如果PPWR中的目标和强制性要求适用于啤酒，那么法律上就有义务将其适用于所有酒精饮料类别。”

source: The 18 December ministerial summit yielded a carve out for winemakers from the requirement that, by the end of the decade, 10% of products must be supplied in reusable containers within a system for reuse or refill, rising to 40% in 2040. The exemption would also apply to the requirement, likewise supported by the European Parliament, that wine should be exempt from deposit-return schemes that should be put in place by 2029 under the proposal.
hypothesis: 12月18日的部长级峰会为葡萄酒商争取到一项豁免，使其不受以下要求的约束：到本十年末，10%的产品必须在可重复使用或可再填充的系统中以可重复使用的容器供应，到2040年这一比例将升至40%。该豁免还适用于另一项同样得到欧洲议会支持的要求，即根据该提案，葡萄酒应豁免于应在2029年前建立的押金返还计划。

source: Both the Czech and Belgian ministers immediately expressed reservations at the 18 December summit about the unequal treatment for brewers, but acquiesced. Belgium, which now chairs the rotating EU Council presidency and is therefore in principle neutral in terms of inter-governmental negotiations, hopes to clinch a deal with the parliament by early March.
hypothesis: 捷克和比利时两国部长在12月18日的峰会上立即对酿酒商受到的不平等待遇表示保留意见，但还是默许了。比利时目前担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国，因此在政府间谈判中原则上保持中立，它希望在3月初之前与议会达成协议。

source: Ignacio Sánchez Recarte, secretary general of the Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins trade association representing some 7,000 wine producers across Europe, is dismissive of the concerns of the beer makers. He told Euronews that a market dominated by multinational brewing conglomerates bears no comparison with one comprised almost entirely of small, domestic producers.
hypothesis: 代表欧洲约7000家葡萄酒生产商的行业组织Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins秘书长伊格纳西奥·桑切斯·雷卡特对啤酒制造商的担忧不屑一顾。他告诉欧洲新闻台，一个由跨国酿酒集团主导的市场，与一个几乎完全由小型本土生产商组成的市场不可相提并论。

source: More than 99% of the domestic wine sector is made up of micro- to medium-sized companies, Sánchez Recarte said, questioning the solidity of legal arguments made by brewers and asserting that his organisation had focused on presenting policy makers with information "relevant and appropriate" to its own industry.
hypothesis: 桑切斯·雷卡特表示，国内葡萄酒行业99%以上由微型到中型企业组成。他质疑酿酒商法律论据的可靠性，并坚称自己的组织一直专注于向政策制定者提供与其行业“相关且适当”的信息。

source: "It is not my role to estimate if the beer sector should have this or that target, as it would depend on the intrinsic characteristics of their own sector," Sánchez Recarte said. "In the same way, brewers should mind their own business and focus on their own responsibilities."
hypothesis: “评估啤酒行业是否应该设定这样或那样的目标不是我的职责，因为这取决于他们自身行业的内在特征，”桑切斯·雷卡特说。“同样，酿酒商应该管好自己的事，专注于自己的责任。”

source: Brewers of Europe shared with Euronews a brief legal analysis it sent to the European Commission last year, where it argues that wine and beer are competing products that are "at least partially, substitutable with each other," and which argued that rules favouring one over the other would distort the market.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商协会与欧洲新闻台分享了一份去年提交给欧盟委员会的法律分析简报，其中主张葡萄酒和啤酒是竞争产品，“至少在一定程度上可以相互替代”，并认为偏袒其中一方的规则将扭曲市场。

source: Simon Spillane, the lobby group's head of operations, said brewers were "already leading the way" in packaging sustainability, citing the example of beer kegs being reused around 165 times before being crushed and recycled after 30 years. They support reuse recycling systems already in place in many countries, he said.
hypothesis: 该游说组织的运营主管西蒙·斯皮兰表示，酿酒商在包装可持续性方面“已经走在前列”，他举例说啤酒桶可重复使用约165次，30年后才被压碎回收。他说，他们支持许多国家已经建立的再利用回收系统。

source: "We therefore advocate for an ambitious PPWR but need a level playing field in packaging legislation where beer and other alcoholic beverages play by the same rules, with each sector contributing fairly to reaching the targets and supporting collection systems," Spillane told. "Any other approach puts the brewers at a competitive disadvantage."
hypothesis: “因此，我们主张制定一项雄心勃勃的PPWR，但需要在包装立法中建立公平的竞争环境，让啤酒和其他酒精饮料遵循相同的规则，每个行业都公平地为实现目标和支持收集系统做出贡献，”斯皮兰说。“任何其他做法都会让酿酒商处于竞争劣势。”

source: The Biden Administration Is Letting Corporate Criminals Off the Hook
hypothesis: 拜登政府正在让企业罪犯逍遥法外

source: Tim Whitehouse, a former EPA enforcement attorney and the executive director of Public Employees for Environmental Responsibility, praised the Biden administration's recent improvements on enforcement while acknowledging the strong headwinds such efforts face. "It takes years of sustained funding and political support to build a good enforcement program," he told me. "The instability in Congress is not only demoralizing to EPA staff but undermines their ability to think strategically over the long term."
hypothesis: 蒂姆·怀特豪斯曾任美国环保署执法律师，现任公职人员环境责任组织执行主任。他称赞拜登政府近期在执法方面的改进，同时也承认这些努力面临强大的阻力。“建立一个良好的执法计划需要多年的持续资金和政治支持，”他告诉我。“国会的不稳定不仅让环保署工作人员士气低落，还削弱了他们进行长期战略思考的能力。”

source: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.
hypothesis: 环保署的问题与司法部的问题虽有不同，但并非毫无关联。司法部通过其环境与自然资源司（ENRD）处理环境犯罪。在加入环保署之前，环保署执法助理署长乌尔曼曾长期担任该司环境犯罪科负责人，任期从1990年到2007年。环保署将其最严重的民事和刑事案件移交给ENRD，而ENRD作为一个资金相对不足的办公室，往往依赖其他机构帮助选择要处理的案件。在2022财年，环保署移交给司法部的案件（88件）比2000年以来的任何时期都少，结案的民事司法案件也比那时以来的任何时期都少。正如环境完整性项目所指出的，即使是特朗普时期的环保署，平均每年也结案94件民事案件，并向司法部移交106件案件。

source: The Department of Justice's overall approach to corporate crimes has come under intense scrutiny from advocates. While watchdogs have lauded some steps the department has taken during Merrick Garland's tenure as attorney general - like finally establishing a database on corporate crime - Biden's DOJ has also leaned heavily on leniency agreements that allow companies to defer or avoid prosecution, and encouraged companies to scapegoat individual employees so as to avoid a broader charge. Kenneth Polite Jr., former assistant attorney general for DOJ's Criminal Division, revised the division's corporate enforcement policy so as to limit prosecutions.
hypothesis: 司法部处理企业犯罪的整体做法受到了倡导人士的密切关注。虽然监督机构对司法部在梅里克·加兰担任司法部长期间采取的一些措施表示赞赏——比如终于建立了企业犯罪数据库——但拜登政府的司法部也严重依赖允许企业推迟或避免起诉的宽大协议，并鼓励企业将个别员工作为替罪羊，以避免更广泛的指控。前司法部刑事司助理司法部长小肯尼斯·波利特修订了该司的企业执法政策，以限制起诉。

source: Siso's depictions of land, water center new gallery exhibition
hypothesis: 西索对土地与水的描绘成为新画廊展览的核心

source: "People Swimming in the Swimming Pool" from 2022 is one Vicente Siso artwork that will display at Tierra del Sol Gallery beginning Jan. 13. (photo courtesy of Vicente Siso)
hypothesis: 2022年的《泳池中游泳的人们》是维森特·西索的一件作品，将于1月13日起在Tierra del Sol画廊展出。（图片由维森特·西索提供）

source: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. Siso has been an artist in the Studio Arts Program since 2012, this marks his debut solo exhibition. Siso was born 1962 in Madrid and raised between Venezuela, Trinidad and Miami; he moved with his family to Southern California in his early 20s.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol很高兴能在西好莱坞的新画廊空间呈现“维森特·西索：土地与水的记忆”。西索自2012年起参与工作室艺术项目，此次展览是他的首次个展。西索1962年出生于马德里，在委内瑞拉、特立尼达和迈阿密之间长大；二十出头时随家人移居南加州。

source: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.
hypothesis: 西索在多种题材间游刃有余，创作了大量风景、肖像和静物作品，媒介涵盖丙烯、粉彩、铅笔和水彩。他从家族肖像、自己的参考照片和回忆中汲取灵感，色彩丰富的构图展现了他广泛的兴趣和跨媒介的技艺。西索的热带风景和海景反映了他过往的地理记忆，运用丰富的图案并融入人物，在文化、记忆与环境之间建立有意义的联系。西索以西班牙语和英语混合的方式为作品命名，体现了他生活在洛杉矶县所经历的复杂而重要的生命历程。“维森特·西索：土地与水的记忆”将于1月13日（周六）开幕，招待会时间为下午6点至8点。展览将持续至3月3日（周日）。

source: The Tierra del Sol Gallery is located at 7414 Santa Monica Blvd. For information, visit tierradelsolgallery.org.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol画廊位于圣莫尼卡大道7414号。如需了解更多信息，请访问tierradelsolgallery.org。

source: Adapt the old, accommodate the new to solve issue
hypothesis: 改造旧有、容纳新生，方能解决问题

source: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.
hypothesis: 在区域层面，我们只需看看悉尼中央商务区这个例子：它从殖民前的自然景观发展成一座两层楼的城市，从最高150英尺的限高发展到今天高耸的塔楼。在规模小得多的层面上，同样的情况也可以发生在悉尼各交通枢纽周边的城镇中心。内城区也必须进化，在关键地块上转向树冠高度以下的更实惠的公寓生活。当然，新增住房需要精心设计，树木、景观和公园以及其他必要基础设施也必须一并纳入。

source: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. A way forward could be to have an independent decision-making body that championed quality design as long as it fitted below the tree tops and incorporated family living, large balconies, common gardens and presented a friendly appearance. This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.
hypothesis: 我们的规划体系也需要调整，以免郊区议会的规划师——他们似乎不太支持变革——成为决定郊区未来形态的唯一力量。一个可行的方向是设立独立的决策机构，只要设计符合树冠以下的高度要求，包含家庭居住空间、大阳台、公共花园，并呈现友好的外观，就予以支持。这可以由现任新南威尔士州政府建筑师在精心制定的合规规范框架内承担这一角色。

source: Over the past decade, our lives have changed through technology, with many working from home, and Sydney has gained an impressive network of metro and light rail systems. Our ability to purchase online has changed the way we shop, and friends and family seem closer because of smartphone communication. All of these adaptations from one system to another can also occur in our built environment through a planning focus on adaptive reuse rather than preferencing heritage preservation.
hypothesis: 过去十年间，科技改变了我们的生活，许多人居家办公，悉尼也建成了令人印象深刻的地铁和轻轨网络。在线购物的能力改变了我们的购物方式，智能手机通讯让朋友和家人似乎更亲近了。所有这些从一个体系到另一个体系的适应，同样可以发生在我们的建成环境中——只要规划聚焦于适应性再利用，而不是一味偏好遗产保护。

source: Chris Johnson is a former NSW government architect (1995-2005) and executive director, NSW Department of Planning (2005-2009). He was CEO of Urban Taskforce Australia between 2011 and 2019.
hypothesis: 克里斯·约翰逊曾任新南威尔士州政府建筑师（1995-2005年）和新南威尔士州规划部执行主任（2005-2009年）。他于2011年至2019年间担任澳大利亚城市工作组首席执行官。

source: A final push for female equality
hypothesis: 为女性平等做最后的冲刺

source: Last year, the World Economic Forum forecast that it would take five generations to achieve gender equality in every nation. Now the World Bank wants to rapidly accelerate that time frame.
hypothesis: 去年，世界经济论坛预测，要在所有国家实现性别平等需要五代人的时间。如今，世界银行希望大幅加快这一进程。

source: The international financial institution is poised to launch a strategy aimed at significantly advancing the rights and economic opportunities for girls and women by 2030. The plan focuses on improving inclusivity and resilience through access to finance, technological innovation, and changes in public policy and law.
hypothesis: 这家国际金融机构准备推出一项战略，旨在到2030年大幅提升女孩和妇女的权利与经济机会。该计划侧重于通过获得金融服务、技术创新以及公共政策和法律的变革来提高包容性和韧性。

source: "Recent research demonstrates that both social norms and mindsets can change, for example, that engaging men and boys can foster their support and buy-in for gender equality," a consultative draft of the plan states. "Positive gender outcomes can be accelerated and scaled with a better understanding of ... how social norms and mindsets shape everyday expectations, priorities, and practices."
hypothesis: 该计划的一份咨询草案指出：“近期研究表明，社会规范和心态都是可以改变的，例如，让男性和男孩参与进来可以促进他们对性别平等的支持和认同。”“如果能更好地理解……社会规范和心态如何塑造日常的期望、优先事项和实践，积极的性别成果就能加速实现并扩大规模。”

source: Shifts in thought are harder to quantify than bank loans for rural women or school enrollment for girls. Yet there is plenty of evidence that female agency can move mountains. In Iran, for example, women have led the greatest threat to the Islamic government in 40 years simply by refusing to comply with laws that force them to cover their hair. In some of the 130 countries with minimum quotas for female representation in government, such as India, male resistance to female voting and political activism has eased.
hypothesis: 思想的转变比向农村妇女发放银行贷款或提高女童入学率更难量化。然而，有大量证据表明，女性的能动性可以移山倒海。例如，在伊朗，女性仅仅通过拒绝遵守强制她们遮盖头发的法律，就对伊斯兰政府构成了40年来最大的威胁。在130个对政府中女性代表比例设有最低配额的国家中，以印度为例，男性对女性投票和政治参与的抵制已经有所缓解。

source: In some rural African communities, civil society organizations are replacing a harmful rite of passage with health education. One such program helped Kamanda Timayio, leader of the Masai village of Maparasha, Kenya, change his mind about female genital mutilation. He told Le Monde that he had "emerged from ignorance" and would abandon the practice.
hypothesis: 在一些非洲农村社区，民间社会组织正在用健康教育取代一种有害的成年礼。其中一个项目帮助肯尼亚马帕拉沙马赛村的首领卡曼达·蒂马约改变了对女性生殖器切割的看法。他告诉《世界报》，自己已经“走出无知”，将放弃这一做法。

source: The World Bank cites other examples. From 1970 to 2022, Bangladesh quadrupled female literacy rates and doubled female participation in the labor force. Its gross domestic product more than tripled. The change gathered its own momentum. Recruiting salaried women as teachers and health workers from within their own communities boosted trust "and made women's mobility and work more socially acceptable."
hypothesis: 世界银行还引用了其他例子。从1970年到2022年，孟加拉国的女性识字率翻了四倍，女性劳动力参与率翻了一番。其国内生产总值增长了两倍多。这种变化形成了自己的势头。从社区内部招募有薪女性担任教师和卫生工作者，增强了信任，“也让女性的流动和工作更容易被社会接受。”

source: The bank's plan would target norms and institutions that may still require generational shifts. It has taken Rwanda more than two decades to establish itself as a model for land reforms that boost economic empowerment for women."No one benefits if women are held back," Rwanda President Paul Kagame said, arguing for land reform in 2015. "We have to change mindsets, not just the laws."
hypothesis: 世界银行的计划将针对可能仍需要代际转变的规范和制度。卢旺达花了二十多年时间才将自己打造成通过土地改革增强女性经济赋权的典范。“如果女性受到阻碍，没有人会受益，”卢旺达总统保罗·卡加梅在2015年为土地改革辩护时说。“我们必须改变心态，而不仅仅是法律。”

source: The World Bank hopes to spread that message.
hypothesis: 世界银行希望传播这一信息。

source: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses
hypothesis: 德国农民和火车司机让德国老板们心惊胆战

source: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.
hypothesis: 在德国，工人和老板共同管理许多公司，大规模罢工并不常见。一波大规模罢工更是闻所未闻。如今，这个“共同决定”的国家正同时面临愤怒农民为期八天的“行动周”（他们用拖拉机封锁道路）、铁路工人为期三天的罢工，以及最糟糕的是，医生们迫在眉睫的罢工——他们已经在圣诞节到元旦期间关闭了诊所。一些人开始称之为“干草叉暴民”（Mistgabelmop），这将在未来一年考验德国和谐的劳资关系。

source: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.
hypothesis: 抗议活动表面上是由政府决定终止农业用柴油补贴并取消农用车辆汽车税豁免引发的。这些措施让农民忍无可忍。这也动员了其他愤怒的工人，他们早已在通货膨胀、经济衰退和政府自我施加的紧缩政策的压力下不堪重负。1月9日，德国国家铁路公司德国铁路的货运和客运列车司机因工作时间和薪酬问题开始罢工。

source: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.
hypothesis: 为了缓和与农民的紧张关系，政府同意在三年内逐步取消柴油补贴，并保留汽车税豁免。农民们对这些让步嗤之以鼻，认为远远不够。1月4日，一群激进的农民阻止经济部长罗伯特·哈贝克在家庭度假归来时下渡轮。智库IW Köln认为，如果火车司机同样不买账，那可能会让德国企业付出高昂代价。铁路罢工如果迫使企业中断生产，每天可能造成1亿欧元（1.1亿美元）的损失。德国最大的汽车、化工和钢铁行业尤其依赖铁路运输。

source: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. The far-right Alternative for Germany party is doing its best to fan the grievances. In Dresden the Free Saxons, another far-right group, infiltrated the farmers" protest calling for the "extinction of the traffic light" (as the governing coalition of the Social Democrats, Free Democrats and Greens is referred to because of their party colours).
hypothesis: 工人们的情绪越来越愤怒。“带有革命幻想的呼吁正在流传，”哈贝克先生警告说。极右翼的德国选择党正竭力煽动不满情绪。在德累斯顿，另一个极右翼组织“自由萨克森人”渗透进了农民的抗议活动，呼吁“消灭红绿灯”（这是对由社会民主党、自由民主党和绿党组成的执政联盟的称呼，因其政党颜色而得名）。

source: Thomas Puls of IW Köln fears that the strikes will harm the image of Germany as a place for business. Local bosses are already fretting about a German version of the gilets jaunes protests in France in 2018, which culminated in yellow-jacketed demonstrators torching cars on the Champs-Elysées and the police stepping in with tear gas. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany's police union, warned in an interview with Tagesspiegel, a daily, that the farmers were probably "just the start of an enormous wave of protest this year." Germany was the only big economy to shrink in 2023, and the year ended on an especially sour note, with an unexpected drop in business confidence in December. This year is shaping up to be even tougher.
hypothesis: IW Köln的托马斯·普尔斯担心罢工将损害德国作为商业目的地的形象。当地老板们已经在担忧德国会出现2018年法国“黄背心”抗议的翻版——那场抗议最终以黄背心示威者在香榭丽舍大街焚烧汽车、警察用催泪瓦斯介入而告终。德国警察工会主席约亨·科佩尔克在接受日报《每日镜报》采访时警告说，农民可能只是“今年巨大抗议浪潮的开端”。德国是2023年唯一出现萎缩的大型经济体，这一年以特别糟糕的基调结束，12月商业信心意外下滑。今年可能会更加艰难。

source: Brewers froth over winemakers" exemption from anti-waste rules
hypothesis: 酿酒商对葡萄酒商豁免反浪费规则感到愤怒

source: As the EU debates rules to limit packaging waste, beer producers argue they are being unfairly discriminated against with exemptions for winemakers from reuse targets and deposit-return schemes, but one of Europe's wine industry association chiefs says brewers should "mind their own business."
hypothesis: 在欧盟就限制包装废弃物的规则进行辩论之际，啤酒生产商认为，葡萄酒商获得再利用目标和押金返还计划的豁免，是对他们的不公平歧视，但欧洲葡萄酒行业协会的一位负责人表示，酿酒商应该“管好自己的事”。

source: European brewers have warned that exempting wine and not beer from deposit return schemes and reuse targets is unfair and potentially illegal, as lawmakers enter final talks over a new law designed to turn a surging tide of packaging waste across the EU.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商警告说，在押金返还计划和再利用目标上豁免葡萄酒而不豁免啤酒是不公平的，甚至可能是非法的。此前，立法者就一项旨在扭转欧盟各地包装废弃物激增趋势的新法律进入最后谈判阶段。

source: Environment ministers agreed an EU Council negotiating mandate on the proposed Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) before Christmas, paving the way for imminent political talks with the European Parliament, which are already underway at the technical level.
hypothesis: 环境部长们在圣诞节前就拟议的《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）达成了欧盟理事会谈判授权，为即将与欧洲议会进行的政治谈判铺平了道路，技术层面的谈判已经在进行中。

source: "Our position is clear," the trade association Brewers of Europe wrote to MEPs and government negotiators (10 January). "If targets and mandatory requirements in the PPWR apply to beer then there is a legal obligation that they apply to all alcoholic beverage categories."
hypothesis: “我们的立场很明确，”行业组织欧洲酿酒商协会在1月10日写给欧洲议会议员和政府谈判代表的信中说。“如果PPWR中的目标和强制性要求适用于啤酒，那么法律上就有义务将其适用于所有酒精饮料类别。”

source: The 18 December ministerial summit yielded a carve out for winemakers from the requirement that, by the end of the decade, 10% of products must be supplied in reusable containers within a system for reuse or refill, rising to 40% in 2040. The exemption would also apply to the requirement, likewise supported by the European Parliament, that wine should be exempt from deposit-return schemes that should be put in place by 2029 under the proposal.
hypothesis: 12月18日的部长级峰会为葡萄酒商争取到了豁免，免除了到本十年末10%的产品必须在可重复使用或可再填充系统中以可重复使用容器供应的要求，该比例到2040年将提高到40%。该豁免也适用于另一项同样得到欧洲议会支持的要求，即根据该提案，葡萄酒应免于2029年前建立的押金返还计划。

source: Both the Czech and Belgian ministers immediately expressed reservations at the 18 December summit about the unequal treatment for brewers, but acquiesced. Belgium, which now chairs the rotating EU Council presidency and is therefore in principle neutral in terms of inter-governmental negotiations, hopes to clinch a deal with the parliament by early March.
hypothesis: 捷克和比利时两国部长在12月18日的峰会上立即对酿酒商受到的不平等待遇表示保留意见，但还是默许了。比利时目前担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国，因此在政府间谈判中原则上保持中立，希望在3月初之前与议会达成协议。

source: Ignacio Sánchez Recarte, secretary general of the Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins trade association representing some 7,000 wine producers across Europe, is dismissive of the concerns of the beer makers. He told Euronews that a market dominated by multinational brewing conglomerates bears no comparison with one comprised almost entirely of small, domestic producers.
hypothesis: 代表欧洲约7000家葡萄酒生产商的行业组织Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins秘书长伊格纳西奥·桑切斯·雷卡特对啤酒制造商的担忧不屑一顾。他告诉欧洲新闻网，一个由跨国酿酒集团主导的市场，与一个几乎完全由小型本土生产商组成的市场不可同日而语。

source: More than 99% of the domestic wine sector is made up of micro- to medium-sized companies, Sánchez Recarte said, questioning the solidity of legal arguments made by brewers and asserting that his organisation had focused on presenting policy makers with information "relevant and appropriate" to its own industry.
