source: As the EU debates rules to limit packaging waste, beer producers argue they are being unfairly discriminated against with exemptions for winemakers from reuse targets and deposit-return schemes, but one of Europe's wine industry association chiefs says brewers should "mind their own business."
hypothesis: 在欧盟就限制包装废弃物的规则进行辩论之际，啤酒生产商声称，葡萄酒生产商获得再利用目标和押金返还计划的豁免，使他们受到了不公平的歧视，但欧洲葡萄酒行业协会的一位负责人表示，酿酒商应该“管好自己分内的事”。

source: European brewers have warned that exempting wine and not beer from deposit return schemes and reuse targets is unfair and potentially illegal, as lawmakers enter final talks over a new law designed to turn a surging tide of packaging waste across the EU.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商警告称，在立法者就一项旨在扭转欧盟各地包装废弃物激增趋势的新法律进行最后谈判之际，将葡萄酒而非啤酒排除在押金返还计划和再利用目标之外是不公平的，甚至可能是违法的。

source: Environment ministers agreed an EU Council negotiating mandate on the proposed Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) before Christmas, paving the way for imminent political talks with the European Parliament, which are already underway at the technical level.
hypothesis: 环境部长们在圣诞节前就拟议的《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）达成了欧盟理事会的谈判授权，为即将与欧洲议会进行的政治谈判铺平了道路，技术层面的谈判已经在进行中。

source: "Our position is clear," the trade association Brewers of Europe wrote to MEPs and government negotiators (10 January). "If targets and mandatory requirements in the PPWR apply to beer then there is a legal obligation that they apply to all alcoholic beverage categories."
hypothesis: 行业协会“欧洲酿酒商”在致欧洲议会议员和政府谈判代表的信函（1月10日）中写道：“我们的立场很明确。如果PPWR中的目标和强制性要求适用于啤酒，那么法律上就有义务将其适用于所有酒精饮料类别。”

source: The 18 December ministerial summit yielded a carve out for winemakers from the requirement that, by the end of the decade, 10% of products must be supplied in reusable containers within a system for reuse or refill, rising to 40% in 2040. The exemption would also apply to the requirement, likewise supported by the European Parliament, that wine should be exempt from deposit-return schemes that should be put in place by 2029 under the proposal.
hypothesis: 12月18日的部长级峰会为葡萄酒生产商争取到一项豁免，免除了他们到本十年末在再利用或再填充系统内以可重复使用容器供应10%产品的要求，该比例到2040年将提高到40%。该豁免同样适用于欧洲议会也支持的另一项要求，即根据该提案，葡萄酒应免于实施押金返还计划，该计划应在2029年前建立。

source: Both the Czech and Belgian ministers immediately expressed reservations at the 18 December summit about the unequal treatment for brewers, but acquiesced. Belgium, which now chairs the rotating EU Council presidency and is therefore in principle neutral in terms of inter-governmental negotiations, hopes to clinch a deal with the parliament by early March.
hypothesis: 捷克和比利时两国部长在12月18日的峰会上立即对酿酒商受到的不平等待遇表示保留意见，但还是默许了。比利时目前担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国，因此在政府间谈判中原则上保持中立，它希望在3月初之前与议会达成协议。

source: Ignacio Sánchez Recarte, secretary general of the Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins trade association representing some 7,000 wine producers across Europe, is dismissive of the concerns of the beer makers. He told Euronews that a market dominated by multinational brewing conglomerates bears no comparison with one comprised almost entirely of small, domestic producers.
hypothesis: 代表欧洲约7000家葡萄酒生产商的葡萄酒企业委员会（Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins）贸易协会秘书长伊格纳西奥·桑切斯·雷卡特对啤酒制造商的担忧不屑一顾。他告诉欧洲新闻台，一个由跨国酿造集团主导的市场，与一个几乎完全由小型本土生产商组成的市场不可相提并论。

source: More than 99% of the domestic wine sector is made up of micro- to medium-sized companies, Sánchez Recarte said, questioning the solidity of legal arguments made by brewers and asserting that his organisation had focused on presenting policy makers with information "relevant and appropriate" to its own industry.
hypothesis: 桑切斯·雷卡特表示，国内葡萄酒行业99%以上由微型至中型企业组成，他质疑酿酒商法律论据的可靠性，并声称他的组织一直专注于向政策制定者提供与其自身行业“相关且适当”的信息。

source: "It is not my role to estimate if the beer sector should have this or that target, as it would depend on the intrinsic characteristics of their own sector," Sánchez Recarte said. "In the same way, brewers should mind their own business and focus on their own responsibilities."
hypothesis: 桑切斯·雷卡特说：“我的职责不是评估啤酒行业应该设定这样或那样的目标，因为这取决于他们自身行业的内在特点。”“同样，酿酒商也应该管好自己分内的事，专注于自己的责任。”

source: Brewers of Europe shared with Euronews a brief legal analysis it sent to the European Commission last year, where it argues that wine and beer are competing products that are "at least partially, substitutable with each other," and which argued that rules favouring one over the other would distort the market.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商与欧洲新闻台分享了一份去年提交给欧盟委员会的法律分析简报，其中指出葡萄酒和啤酒是竞争产品，“至少在一定程度上可以相互替代”，并认为偏袒其中一方的规则将扭曲市场。

source: Simon Spillane, the lobby group's head of operations, said brewers were "already leading the way" in packaging sustainability, citing the example of beer kegs being reused around 165 times before being crushed and recycled after 30 years. They support reuse recycling systems already in place in many countries, he said.
hypothesis: 该游说团体的运营主管西蒙·斯皮兰表示，酿酒商在包装可持续性方面“已经走在前列”，他举例说，啤酒桶在被压碎并在30年后回收之前，大约会被重复使用165次。他说，他们支持许多国家已经建立的再利用回收系统。

source: "We therefore advocate for an ambitious PPWR but need a level playing field in packaging legislation where beer and other alcoholic beverages play by the same rules, with each sector contributing fairly to reaching the targets and supporting collection systems," Spillane told. "Any other approach puts the brewers at a competitive disadvantage."
hypothesis: 斯皮兰表示：“因此，我们主张制定一项雄心勃勃的PPWR，但包装立法需要公平的竞争环境，让啤酒和其他酒精饮料遵守相同的规则，每个行业都为达成目标和支持收集系统做出公平的贡献。”“任何其他做法都会使酿酒商处于竞争劣势。”

source: The Biden Administration Is Letting Corporate Criminals Off the Hook
hypothesis: 拜登政府正让企业罪犯逍遥法外

source: Tim Whitehouse, a former EPA enforcement attorney and the executive director of Public Employees for Environmental Responsibility, praised the Biden administration's recent improvements on enforcement while acknowledging the strong headwinds such efforts face. "It takes years of sustained funding and political support to build a good enforcement program," he told me. "The instability in Congress is not only demoralizing to EPA staff but undermines their ability to think strategically over the long term."
hypothesis: 前环保署执法律师、现任“公职人员环境责任组织”执行主任蒂姆·怀特豪斯赞扬了拜登政府近期在执法方面的改进，同时也承认这些努力面临巨大的阻力。他告诉我：“建立一个良好的执法计划需要多年的持续资金和政治支持。”“国会的不稳定不仅让环保署工作人员士气低落，而且削弱了他们进行长期战略思考的能力。”

source: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.
hypothesis: 环保署的问题与司法部的问题虽有不同，但并非毫无关联。司法部通过其环境与自然资源部（ENRD）处理环境犯罪。在加入环保署之前，环保署负责执法的助理部长乌尔曼曾长期担任该部门环境犯罪科负责人，任期从1990年到2007年。环保署将其最严重的民事和刑事案件移交给ENRD，而ENRD作为一个资金相对不足的办公室，常常依赖其他机构来帮助选择要处理的案件。在2022财年，环保署移交给司法部的案件（88件）比2000年以来的任何时期都少，结案的民事司法案件数量也是同期最低。正如环境完整性项目所指出的，即使是特朗普时期的环保署，平均每年也结案94起民事案件，并向司法部移交106起案件。

source: The Department of Justice's overall approach to corporate crimes has come under intense scrutiny from advocates. While watchdogs have lauded some steps the department has taken during Merrick Garland's tenure as attorney general - like finally establishing a database on corporate crime - Biden's DOJ has also leaned heavily on leniency agreements that allow companies to defer or avoid prosecution, and encouraged companies to scapegoat individual employees so as to avoid a broader charge. Kenneth Polite Jr., former assistant attorney general for DOJ's Criminal Division, revised the division's corporate enforcement policy so as to limit prosecutions.
hypothesis: 司法部处理企业犯罪的整体做法受到了维权人士的密切关注。虽然监督机构赞扬了该部门在梅里克·加兰担任司法部长期间采取的一些措施——比如最终建立了企业犯罪数据库——但拜登领导下的司法部也严重依赖允许企业推迟或避免起诉的宽大协议，并鼓励企业将责任推给个别员工，以避免更广泛的指控。前司法部刑事司助理部长小肯尼斯·波利特修改了该司的企业执法政策，以限制起诉。

source: Siso's depictions of land, water center new gallery exhibition
hypothesis: Siso对土地与水的描绘成为新画廊展览的核心

source: "People Swimming in the Swimming Pool" from 2022 is one Vicente Siso artwork that will display at Tierra del Sol Gallery beginning Jan. 13. (photo courtesy of Vicente Siso)
hypothesis: 2022年的《游泳池中游泳的人们》是Vicente Siso的一件作品，将于1月13日起在Tierra del Sol画廊展出。（照片由Vicente Siso提供）

source: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. Siso has been an artist in the Studio Arts Program since 2012, this marks his debut solo exhibition. Siso was born 1962 in Madrid and raised between Venezuela, Trinidad and Miami; he moved with his family to Southern California in his early 20s.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol很高兴在西好莱坞的新画廊地点呈现“Vicente Siso：土地与水的记忆”。Siso自2012年以来一直是工作室艺术项目的艺术家，这标志着他首次举办个人展览。Siso于1962年出生在马德里，在委内瑞拉、特立尼达和迈阿密之间长大；他在二十出头时随家人搬到了南加州。

source: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.
hypothesis: Siso在题材上驾轻就熟，创作了大量风景画、肖像画和静物作品，使用丙烯、粉彩、铅笔或水彩绘制。他从家庭肖像、自己的参考照片和回忆中汲取灵感，色彩丰富的构图展示了他跨媒介的兴趣和技巧。Siso的热带风景和海景反映了他过去的地理环境，运用丰富的图案并融入人物，在文化、记忆和环境之间建立有意义的联系。Siso用西班牙语和英语混合为作品命名，体现他在洛杉矶县生活中备受赞誉且不可或缺的复杂性。“Vicente Siso：土地与水的记忆”将于1月13日（星期六）开幕，招待会时间为下午6点至8点。展览将持续至3月3日（星期日）。

source: The Tierra del Sol Gallery is located at 7414 Santa Monica Blvd. For information, visit tierradelsolgallery.org.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol画廊位于圣莫尼卡大道7414号。如需了解更多信息，请访问tierradelsolgallery.org。

source: Adapt the old, accommodate the new to solve issue
hypothesis: 适应旧有，容纳新生，以解决问题

source: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.
hypothesis: 在区域层面，我们只需看看悉尼中央商务区这个例子，它从前殖民时期的景观发展成为一个两层楼的城市，从最高150英尺到如今高耸的塔楼。在规模小得多的层面上，同样的情况可以发生在悉尼围绕交通枢纽的城镇中心。内城区也必须发展，转向在关键地点树冠高度以下更实惠的公寓生活。当然，新的住房增长需要精心设计，树木、景观绿化和公园以及其他必要的基础设施也需要包括在内。

source: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. A way forward could be to have an independent decision-making body that championed quality design as long as it fitted below the tree tops and incorporated family living, large balconies, common gardens and presented a friendly appearance. This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.
hypothesis: 我们的规划系统也需要调整，以便郊区议会的规划者（他们似乎不太支持变革）不再是决定其郊区未来形态的唯一因素。一个前进的方向可能是设立一个独立的决策机构，只要设计符合树冠以下的高度，并包含家庭生活、大阳台、公共花园，且外观友好，就支持优质设计。这可能是新南威尔士州现任政府建筑师在精心制定的合规规范内发挥的作用。

source: Over the past decade, our lives have changed through technology, with many working from home, and Sydney has gained an impressive network of metro and light rail systems. Our ability to purchase online has changed the way we shop, and friends and family seem closer because of smartphone communication. All of these adaptations from one system to another can also occur in our built environment through a planning focus on adaptive reuse rather than preferencing heritage preservation.
hypothesis: 在过去十年中，科技改变了我们的生活，许多人居家办公，悉尼也拥有了令人印象深刻的地铁和轻轨系统网络。我们在线购物的能力改变了购物方式，智能手机通讯让朋友和家人似乎更亲近了。所有这些从一个系统到另一个系统的适应，也可以通过规划重点放在适应性再利用而非偏好遗产保护上，在我们的建筑环境中实现。

source: Chris Johnson is a former NSW government architect (1995-2005) and executive director, NSW Department of Planning (2005-2009). He was CEO of Urban Taskforce Australia between 2011 and 2019.
hypothesis: Chris Johnson曾任新南威尔士州政府建筑师（1995-2005年）和新南威尔士州规划部执行主任（2005-2009年）。他在2011年至2019年间担任澳大利亚城市工作组首席执行官。

source: A final push for female equality
hypothesis: 为女性平等做最后冲刺

source: Last year, the World Economic Forum forecast that it would take five generations to achieve gender equality in every nation. Now the World Bank wants to rapidly accelerate that time frame.
hypothesis: 去年，世界经济论坛预测，要在每个国家实现性别平等需要五代人的时间。现在，世界银行希望大幅加快这一时间表。

source: The international financial institution is poised to launch a strategy aimed at significantly advancing the rights and economic opportunities for girls and women by 2030. The plan focuses on improving inclusivity and resilience through access to finance, technological innovation, and changes in public policy and law.
hypothesis: 这家国际金融机构准备推出一项战略，旨在到2030年大幅提升女孩和妇女的权利与经济机会。该计划侧重于通过获得金融服务、技术创新以及公共政策和法律的变化来提高包容性和韧性。

source: "Recent research demonstrates that both social norms and mindsets can change, for example, that engaging men and boys can foster their support and buy-in for gender equality," a consultative draft of the plan states. "Positive gender outcomes can be accelerated and scaled with a better understanding of ... how social norms and mindsets shape everyday expectations, priorities, and practices."
hypothesis: 该计划的一份咨询草案指出：“最近的研究表明，社会规范和心态都可以改变，例如，让男性和男孩参与进来可以促进他们对性别平等的支持和认同。”“通过更好地理解……社会规范和心态如何塑造日常期望、优先事项和实践，可以加速并扩大积极的性别成果。”

source: Shifts in thought are harder to quantify than bank loans for rural women or school enrollment for girls. Yet there is plenty of evidence that female agency can move mountains. In Iran, for example, women have led the greatest threat to the Islamic government in 40 years simply by refusing to comply with laws that force them to cover their hair. In some of the 130 countries with minimum quotas for female representation in government, such as India, male resistance to female voting and political activism has eased.
hypothesis: 思想上的转变比向农村妇女提供银行贷款或女孩入学更难量化。然而，有大量证据表明，女性的能动性可以移山。例如，在伊朗，女性仅仅通过拒绝遵守强制她们遮盖头发的法律，就对伊斯兰政府构成了40年来最大的威胁。在130个对政府中女性代表设有最低配额的国家中，例如印度，男性对女性投票和政治活动的抵制已经有所缓解。

source: In some rural African communities, civil society organizations are replacing a harmful rite of passage with health education. One such program helped Kamanda Timayio, leader of the Masai village of Maparasha, Kenya, change his mind about female genital mutilation. He told Le Monde that he had "emerged from ignorance" and would abandon the practice.
hypothesis: 在一些非洲农村社区，民间社会组织正在用健康教育取代一种有害的成年礼。其中一个项目帮助肯尼亚马帕拉沙马赛村村长Kamanda Timayio改变了对女性生殖器切割的看法。他告诉《世界报》，他已经“摆脱了无知”，并将放弃这种做法。

source: The World Bank cites other examples. From 1970 to 2022, Bangladesh quadrupled female literacy rates and doubled female participation in the labor force. Its gross domestic product more than tripled. The change gathered its own momentum. Recruiting salaried women as teachers and health workers from within their own communities boosted trust "and made women's mobility and work more socially acceptable."
hypothesis: 世界银行还引用了其他例子。从1970年到2022年，孟加拉国的女性识字率翻了两番，女性劳动力参与率翻了一番。其国内生产总值增长了两倍多。这种变化自身也积累了动力。从社区内部招募有薪女性担任教师和卫生工作者，增强了信任，“并使女性的流动和工作更被社会接受。”

source: The bank's plan would target norms and institutions that may still require generational shifts. It has taken Rwanda more than two decades to establish itself as a model for land reforms that boost economic empowerment for women."No one benefits if women are held back," Rwanda President Paul Kagame said, arguing for land reform in 2015. "We have to change mindsets, not just the laws."
hypothesis: 该银行的计划将针对可能仍需要代际转变的规范和制度。卢旺达花了二十多年时间才将自己确立为促进妇女经济赋权的土地改革典范。卢旺达总统Paul Kagame在2015年为土地改革辩护时说：“如果女性受到阻碍，没有人会受益。”“我们必须改变心态，而不仅仅是法律。”

source: The World Bank hopes to spread that message.
hypothesis: 世界银行希望传播这一信息。

source: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses
hypothesis: 德国农民和火车司机让德国老板们感到恐慌

source: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.
hypothesis: 在德国，工人和老板共同管理许多公司，大规模罢工并不常见。一波大规模罢工几乎闻所未闻。目前，这个“共同决定”的国家同时面临着愤怒农民为期八天的“行动周”（他们用拖拉机封锁道路）、铁路工人为期三天的罢工，以及最糟糕的是，医生即将举行的罢工（他们已经在圣诞节和元旦之间关闭了诊所）。这个被一些人称为“干草叉暴民”的群体，将在未来一年考验德国和谐的劳资关系。

source: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.
hypothesis: 抗议活动表面上是由政府决定终止农业用柴油补贴并取消农用车辆汽车税豁免引发的。这些措施让农民忍无可忍。这也动员了其他愤怒的工人，他们已经在通货膨胀、经济衰退和政府自我施加的紧缩压力下不堪重负。1月9日，国家铁路公司德国铁路的货运和客运列车司机因工作时间和薪酬开始罢工。

source: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.
hypothesis: 为了缓和与农民的紧张关系，政府同意在三年内逐步取消柴油补贴，并保留汽车税豁免。农民们对这些让步不屑一顾，认为不够充分。1月4日，一群激进的农民阻止了经济部长Robert Habeck在家庭度假归来后下渡轮。智库IW Köln认为，如果火车司机同样不买账，那可能会让德国企业付出高昂代价。如果铁路罢工迫使企业中断生产，每天可能造成1亿欧元（1.1亿美元）的损失。德国最大的汽车、化工和钢铁行业尤其依赖铁路运输。

source: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. The far-right Alternative for Germany party is doing its best to fan the grievances. In Dresden the Free Saxons, another far-right group, infiltrated the farmers" protest calling for the "extinction of the traffic light" (as the governing coalition of the Social Democrats, Free Democrats and Greens is referred to because of their party colours).
hypothesis: 工人们的情绪越来越愤怒。“带有革命幻想的呼吁正在流传，”Habeck先生警告说。极右翼的德国选择党正在尽力煽动不满情绪。在德累斯顿，另一个极右翼组织“自由萨克森人”渗透进了农民的抗议活动，呼吁“消灭红绿灯”（这是对由社会民主党、自由民主党和绿党组成的执政联盟的称呼，因为他们的政党颜色）。

source: Thomas Puls of IW Köln fears that the strikes will harm the image of Germany as a place for business. Local bosses are already fretting about a German version of the gilets jaunes protests in France in 2018, which culminated in yellow-jacketed demonstrators torching cars on the Champs-Elysées and the police stepping in with tear gas. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany's police union, warned in an interview with Tagesspiegel, a daily, that the farmers were probably "just the start of an enormous wave of protest this year." Germany was the only big economy to shrink in 2023, and the year ended on an especially sour note, with an unexpected drop in business confidence in December. This year is shaping up to be even tougher.
hypothesis: IW Köln的Thomas Puls担心罢工将损害德国作为商业场所的形象。当地老板们已经在担心德国会出现2018年法国“黄背心”抗议活动的翻版，那次抗议最终以身穿黄背心的示威者在香榭丽舍大街焚烧汽车、警察使用催泪瓦斯介入而告终。德国警察工会负责人Jochen Kopelke在接受日报《每日镜报》采访时警告说，农民可能“只是今年巨大抗议浪潮的开始”。德国是2023年唯一出现萎缩的大型经济体，这一年以特别糟糕的基调结束，12月份商业信心意外下降。今年将会更加艰难。

source: Brewers froth over winemakers" exemption from anti-waste rules
hypothesis: 酿酒商对葡萄酒商豁免反浪费规则感到愤怒

source: As the EU debates rules to limit packaging waste, beer producers argue they are being unfairly discriminated against with exemptions for winemakers from reuse targets and deposit-return schemes, but one of Europe's wine industry association chiefs says brewers should "mind their own business."
hypothesis: 在欧盟讨论限制包装废弃物的规则之际，啤酒生产商认为他们受到了不公平的歧视，因为葡萄酒商被豁免了再利用目标和押金返还计划，但欧洲葡萄酒行业协会的一位负责人表示，酿酒商应该“管好自己的事”。

source: European brewers have warned that exempting wine and not beer from deposit return schemes and reuse targets is unfair and potentially illegal, as lawmakers enter final talks over a new law designed to turn a surging tide of packaging waste across the EU.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商警告说，在立法者就一项旨在扭转欧盟各地包装废弃物激增趋势的新法律进行最后谈判之际，将葡萄酒而非啤酒排除在押金返还计划和再利用目标之外是不公平的，而且可能违法。

source: Environment ministers agreed an EU Council negotiating mandate on the proposed Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) before Christmas, paving the way for imminent political talks with the European Parliament, which are already underway at the technical level.
hypothesis: 环境部长们在圣诞节前就拟议的《包装和包装废弃物法规》达成了欧盟理事会谈判授权，为即将与欧洲议会进行的政治谈判铺平了道路，技术层面的谈判已经在进行中。

source: "Our position is clear," the trade association Brewers of Europe wrote to MEPs and government negotiators (10 January). "If targets and mandatory requirements in the PPWR apply to beer then there is a legal obligation that they apply to all alcoholic beverage categories."
hypothesis: “我们的立场很明确，”行业协会“欧洲酿酒商”在1月10日写给欧洲议会议员和政府谈判代表的信中说。“如果PPWR中的目标和强制性要求适用于啤酒，那么法律上就有义务将其适用于所有酒精饮料类别。”

source: The 18 December ministerial summit yielded a carve out for winemakers from the requirement that, by the end of the decade, 10% of products must be supplied in reusable containers within a system for reuse or refill, rising to 40% in 2040. The exemption would also apply to the requirement, likewise supported by the European Parliament, that wine should be exempt from deposit-return schemes that should be put in place by 2029 under the proposal.
hypothesis: 12月18日的部长级峰会为葡萄酒商争取到了豁免，免除了到本十年末，10%的产品必须在可重复使用或再填充系统中以可重复使用容器供应的要求，该比例到2040年将提高到40%。该豁免也适用于欧洲议会同样支持的要求，即根据该提案，葡萄酒应免于在2029年前实施的押金返还计划。

source: Both the Czech and Belgian ministers immediately expressed reservations at the 18 December summit about the unequal treatment for brewers, but acquiesced. Belgium, which now chairs the rotating EU Council presidency and is therefore in principle neutral in terms of inter-governmental negotiations, hopes to clinch a deal with the parliament by early March.
hypothesis: 捷克和比利时部长在12月18日的峰会上立即对酿酒商受到的不平等待遇表示保留意见，但默许了。比利时目前担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国，因此在政府间谈判中原则上保持中立，希望在三月初与议会达成协议。

source: Ignacio Sánchez Recarte, secretary general of the Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins trade association representing some 7,000 wine producers across Europe, is dismissive of the concerns of the beer makers. He told Euronews that a market dominated by multinational brewing conglomerates bears no comparison with one comprised almost entirely of small, domestic producers.
hypothesis: 代表欧洲约7000家葡萄酒生产商的贸易协会Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins的秘书长Ignacio Sánchez Recarte对啤酒制造商的担忧不屑一顾。他告诉欧洲新闻台，一个由跨国酿造集团主导的市场与一个几乎完全由小型国内生产商组成的市场无法相提并论。

source: More than 99% of the domestic wine sector is made up of micro- to medium-sized companies, Sánchez Recarte said, questioning the solidity of legal arguments made by brewers and asserting that his organisation had focused on presenting policy makers with information "relevant and appropriate" to its own industry.
hypothesis: Sánchez Recarte表示，国内葡萄酒行业99%以上由微型到中型企业组成，他质疑酿酒商提出的法律论据的可靠性，并断言他的组织一直专注于向政策制定者提供与其自身行业“相关且适当”的信息。

source: "It is not my role to estimate if the beer sector should have this or that target, as it would depend on the intrinsic characteristics of their own sector," Sánchez Recarte said. "In the same way, brewers should mind their own business and focus on their own responsibilities."
hypothesis: “评估啤酒行业是否应该有这样或那样的目标不是我的职责，因为这取决于他们自身行业的内在特征，”Sánchez Recarte说。“同样，酿酒商应该管好自己的事，专注于自己的责任。”

source: Brewers of Europe shared with Euronews a brief legal analysis it sent to the European Commission last year, where it argues that wine and beer are competing products that are "at least partially, substitutable with each other," and which argued that rules favouring one over the other would distort the market.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商与欧洲新闻台分享了一份去年发送给欧盟委员会的法律分析简报，其中辩称葡萄酒和啤酒是竞争产品，“至少在一定程度上可以相互替代”，并认为偏袒其中一种的规则会扭曲市场。

source: Simon Spillane, the lobby group's head of operations, said brewers were "already leading the way" in packaging sustainability, citing the example of beer kegs being reused around 165 times before being crushed and recycled after 30 years. They support reuse recycling systems already in place in many countries, he said.
hypothesis: 该游说团体的运营主管Simon Spillane表示，酿酒商在包装可持续性方面“已经领先”，他举例说，啤酒桶在30年后被压碎回收之前大约被重复使用165次。他说，他们支持许多国家已经建立的再利用回收系统。

source: "We therefore advocate for an ambitious PPWR but need a level playing field in packaging legislation where beer and other alcoholic beverages play by the same rules, with each sector contributing fairly to reaching the targets and supporting collection systems," Spillane told. "Any other approach puts the brewers at a competitive disadvantage."
hypothesis: “因此，我们主张制定一项雄心勃勃的PPWR，但需要在包装立法中有一个公平的竞争环境，让啤酒和其他酒精饮料遵守相同的规则，每个行业都公平地为实现目标和支持收集系统做出贡献，”Spillane说。“任何其他做法都会使酿酒商处于竞争劣势。”

source: The Biden Administration Is Letting Corporate Criminals Off the Hook
hypothesis: 拜登政府正在让企业罪犯逍遥法外

source: Tim Whitehouse, a former EPA enforcement attorney and the executive director of Public Employees for Environmental Responsibility, praised the Biden administration's recent improvements on enforcement while acknowledging the strong headwinds such efforts face. "It takes years of sustained funding and political support to build a good enforcement program," he told me. "The instability in Congress is not only demoralizing to EPA staff but undermines their ability to think strategically over the long term."
hypothesis: 前环保署执法律师、公职人员环境责任组织执行主任Tim Whitehouse赞扬了拜登政府近期在执法方面的改进，同时承认这些努力面临强大的阻力。“建立一个良好的执法计划需要多年的持续资金和政治支持，”他告诉我。“国会的不稳定不仅让环保署工作人员士气低落，而且削弱了他们长期战略思考的能力。”

source: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.
hypothesis: 环保署的问题与司法部的问题不同，但并非无关。司法部通过其环境与自然资源司处理环境犯罪。在加入环保署之前，环保署执法助理部长Uhlmann曾长期担任该司环境犯罪科负责人，从1990年到2007年。环保署将其最严重的民事和刑事案件移交给环境与自然资源司，而该司作为一个资金相对不足的办公室，通常依赖其他机构帮助选择要处理的案件。在2022财年，环保署移交给司法部的案件（88件）比2000年以来的任何时候都少，结案的民事司法案件也比那时以来的任何时候都少。正如环境完整性项目所指出的，即使是特朗普时期的环保署，平均每年也结案94件民事案件，并向司法部移送106件案件。

source: The Department of Justice's overall approach to corporate crimes has come under intense scrutiny from advocates. While watchdogs have lauded some steps the department has taken during Merrick Garland's tenure as attorney general - like finally establishing a database on corporate crime - Biden's DOJ has also leaned heavily on leniency agreements that allow companies to defer or avoid prosecution, and encouraged companies to scapegoat individual employees so as to avoid a broader charge. Kenneth Polite Jr., former assistant attorney general for DOJ's Criminal Division, revised the division's corporate enforcement policy so as to limit prosecutions.
hypothesis: 司法部处理企业犯罪的整体做法受到了倡导者的密切关注。虽然监督机构赞扬了该部在Merrick Garland担任司法部长期间采取的一些措施——比如最终建立了企业犯罪数据库——但拜登领导下的司法部也严重依赖允许企业推迟或避免起诉的宽大协议，并鼓励企业将个别员工当作替罪羊，以避免更广泛的指控。前司法部刑事司助理司法部长Kenneth Polite Jr.修订了该司的企业执法政策，以限制起诉。

source: Siso's depictions of land, water center new gallery exhibition
hypothesis: Siso对土地与水的描绘成为新画廊展览的核心

source: "People Swimming in the Swimming Pool" from 2022 is one Vicente Siso artwork that will display at Tierra del Sol Gallery beginning Jan. 13. (photo courtesy of Vicente Siso)
hypothesis: 2022年的《游泳池中游泳的人们》是Vicente Siso的一件艺术作品，将于1月13日起在Tierra del Sol画廊展出。（照片由Vicente Siso提供）

source: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. Siso has been an artist in the Studio Arts Program since 2012, this marks his debut solo exhibition. Siso was born 1962 in Madrid and raised between Venezuela, Trinidad and Miami; he moved with his family to Southern California in his early 20s.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol很高兴能在西好莱坞的新画廊地点呈现“Vicente Siso：土地与水的记忆”。Siso自2012年起一直是工作室艺术项目的艺术家，此次展览标志着他首次个人展览。Siso于1962年出生于马德里，在委内瑞拉、特立尼达和迈阿密之间长大；他在二十出头时随家人搬到南加州。

source: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.
hypothesis: Siso在题材上驾驭自如，创作了大量风景画、肖像画和静物作品，使用丙烯、粉彩、铅笔或水彩绘制。他借鉴家庭肖像、自己的参考照片和回忆，其色彩丰富的构图展现了他广泛的兴趣和跨媒介的技巧。Siso的热带风景和海景反映了他过去的地理环境，运用丰富的图案并融入人物，在文化、记忆和环境之间建立有意义的联系。Siso用西班牙语和英语混合为作品命名，体现他在洛杉矶县生活中备受赞誉且不可或缺的复杂性。“Vicente Siso：土地与水的记忆”将于1月13日（星期六）开幕，招待会时间为下午6点至8点。展览将持续至3月3日（星期日）。

source: The Tierra del Sol Gallery is located at 7414 Santa Monica Blvd. For information, visit tierradelsolgallery.org.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol画廊位于圣莫尼卡大道7414号。如需了解更多信息，请访问tierradelsolgallery.org。

source: Adapt the old, accommodate the new to solve issue
hypothesis: 改造旧有，容纳新生，以解决问题

source: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.
hypothesis: 在区域层面，我们只需看看悉尼中央商务区，它已从定居前的景观发展成为一个两层楼的城市，从最高150英尺到如今高耸的塔楼。在规模小得多的层面上，同样的情况可以发生在悉尼围绕交通枢纽的城镇中心。内城区也必须发展，转向在关键地点树冠高度以下更实惠的公寓生活。当然，新的住房增长需要精心设计，树木、景观绿化和公园以及其他必要的基础设施也需要包括在内。

source: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. A way forward could be to have an independent decision-making body that championed quality design as long as it fitted below the tree tops and incorporated family living, large balconies, common gardens and presented a friendly appearance. This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.
hypothesis: 我们的规划系统也需要调整，以便郊区议会的规划者（他们似乎不太支持变革）不再是决定其郊区未来形态的唯一因素。一个前进的方向可能是设立一个独立的决策机构，只要设计符合树冠以下的高度，并包含家庭居住、大阳台、公共花园，且外观友好，就支持优质设计。这可能是新南威尔士州现任政府建筑师在精心制定的合规规范内发挥的作用。

source: Over the past decade, our lives have changed through technology, with many working from home, and Sydney has gained an impressive network of metro and light rail systems. Our ability to purchase online has changed the way we shop, and friends and family seem closer because of smartphone communication. All of these adaptations from one system to another can also occur in our built environment through a planning focus on adaptive reuse rather than preferencing heritage preservation.
hypothesis: 在过去十年中，科技改变了我们的生活，许多人居家办公，悉尼也拥有了令人印象深刻的地铁和轻轨系统网络。我们在线购物的能力改变了购物方式，智能手机通讯让朋友和家人似乎更亲近了。所有这些从一个系统到另一个系统的适应，也可以通过规划重点放在适应性再利用而非优先考虑遗产保护上，在我们的建筑环境中实现。

source: Chris Johnson is a former NSW government architect (1995-2005) and executive director, NSW Department of Planning (2005-2009). He was CEO of Urban Taskforce Australia between 2011 and 2019.
hypothesis: Chris Johnson曾任新南威尔士州政府建筑师（1995-2005年）和新南威尔士州规划部执行主任（2005-2009年）。他在2011年至2019年间担任澳大利亚城市工作组首席执行官。

source: A final push for female equality
hypothesis: 为女性平等做最后冲刺

source: Last year, the World Economic Forum forecast that it would take five generations to achieve gender equality in every nation. Now the World Bank wants to rapidly accelerate that time frame.
hypothesis: 去年，世界经济论坛预测，要在每个国家实现性别平等需要五代人的时间。现在，世界银行希望大幅加快这一时间表。

source: The international financial institution is poised to launch a strategy aimed at significantly advancing the rights and economic opportunities for girls and women by 2030. The plan focuses on improving inclusivity and resilience through access to finance, technological innovation, and changes in public policy and law.
hypothesis: 这家国际金融机构准备推出一项战略，旨在到2030年大幅提升女孩和妇女的权利与经济机会。该计划侧重于通过获得金融服务、技术创新以及公共政策和法律的变革来提高包容性和韧性。

source: "Recent research demonstrates that both social norms and mindsets can change, for example, that engaging men and boys can foster their support and buy-in for gender equality," a consultative draft of the plan states. "Positive gender outcomes can be accelerated and scaled with a better understanding of ... how social norms and mindsets shape everyday expectations, priorities, and practices."
hypothesis: “最近的研究表明，社会规范和心态都是可以改变的，例如，让男性和男孩参与进来可以促进他们对性别平等的支持和认同，”该计划的一份咨询草案指出。“通过更好地理解……社会规范和心态如何塑造日常期望、优先事项和实践，可以加速并扩大积极的性别成果。”

source: Shifts in thought are harder to quantify than bank loans for rural women or school enrollment for girls. Yet there is plenty of evidence that female agency can move mountains. In Iran, for example, women have led the greatest threat to the Islamic government in 40 years simply by refusing to comply with laws that force them to cover their hair. In some of the 130 countries with minimum quotas for female representation in government, such as India, male resistance to female voting and political activism has eased.
hypothesis: 思想上的转变比向农村妇女提供银行贷款或女孩入学更难量化。然而，有大量证据表明，女性的能动性可以移山。例如，在伊朗，女性仅仅通过拒绝遵守强制她们遮盖头发的法律，就对伊斯兰政府构成了40年来最大的威胁。在130个对政府中女性代表设有最低配额的国家中，例如印度，男性对女性投票和政治活动的抵制已经有所缓解。

source: In some rural African communities, civil society organizations are replacing a harmful rite of passage with health education. One such program helped Kamanda Timayio, leader of the Masai village of Maparasha, Kenya, change his mind about female genital mutilation. He told Le Monde that he had "emerged from ignorance" and would abandon the practice.
hypothesis: 在一些非洲农村社区，民间社会组织正在用健康教育取代一种有害的成年礼。其中一个项目帮助肯尼亚马帕拉沙马赛村村长Kamanda Timayio改变了对女性生殖器切割的看法。他告诉《世界报》，他已经“摆脱了无知”，并将放弃这种做法。

source: The World Bank cites other examples. From 1970 to 2022, Bangladesh quadrupled female literacy rates and doubled female participation in the labor force. Its gross domestic product more than tripled. The change gathered its own momentum. Recruiting salaried women as teachers and health workers from within their own communities boosted trust "and made women's mobility and work more socially acceptable."
hypothesis: 世界银行还引用了其他例子。从1970年到2022年，孟加拉国的女性识字率翻了两番，女性劳动力参与率翻了一番。其国内生产总值增长了两倍多。这种变化形成了自己的势头。从社区内部招募有薪女性担任教师和卫生工作者，增强了信任，“并使女性的流动和工作更被社会接受”。

source: The bank's plan would target norms and institutions that may still require generational shifts. It has taken Rwanda more than two decades to establish itself as a model for land reforms that boost economic empowerment for women."No one benefits if women are held back," Rwanda President Paul Kagame said, arguing for land reform in 2015. "We have to change mindsets, not just the laws."
hypothesis: 该银行的计划将针对可能仍需要代际转变的规范和制度。卢旺达花了二十多年时间才将自己确立为促进妇女经济赋权的土地改革典范。“如果妇女受到阻碍，没有人会受益，”卢旺达总统保罗·卡加梅在2015年为土地改革辩护时说。“我们必须改变心态，而不仅仅是法律。”

source: The World Bank hopes to spread that message.
hypothesis: 世界银行希望传播这一信息。

source: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses
hypothesis: 德国农民和火车司机让德国老板们感到恐慌

source: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.
hypothesis: 在德国，工人和老板共同管理许多公司，大规模罢工并不常见。一波大规模罢工几乎闻所未闻。目前，这个“共同决定”的国家同时面临着愤怒农民为期八天的“行动周”（他们用拖拉机封锁道路）、铁路工人为期三天的罢工，以及最糟糕的是，医生即将举行的罢工（他们已经在圣诞节和元旦之间关闭了诊所）。一些人开始称之为“干草叉暴民”（Mistgabelmop），这将在未来一年考验德国和谐的劳资关系。

source: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.
hypothesis: 抗议活动表面上是由政府决定终止农业用柴油补贴并取消农用车辆汽车税豁免引发的。这些措施让农民忍无可忍。这也动员了其他愤怒的工人，他们已经在通货膨胀、经济衰退和政府自我施加的紧缩压力下不堪重负。1月9日，德国国家铁路公司德国铁路的货运和客运列车司机因工作时间和薪酬问题开始罢工。

source: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.
hypothesis: 为了缓和与农民的紧张关系，政府同意在三年内逐步取消柴油补贴，并保留汽车税豁免。农民们对这些让步不屑一顾，认为不够。1月4日，一群激进的农民阻止了经济部长罗伯特·哈贝克在家庭度假归来后下渡轮。智库IW Köln认为，如果火车司机同样不买账，那可能会让德国企业付出高昂代价。如果铁路罢工迫使企业中断生产，每天可能造成1亿欧元（1.1亿美元）的损失。德国最大的汽车、化工和钢铁行业尤其依赖铁路运输。

source: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. The far-right Alternative for Germany party is doing its best to fan the grievances. In Dresden the Free Saxons, another far-right group, infiltrated the farmers" protest calling for the "extinction of the traffic light" (as the governing coalition of the Social Democrats, Free Democrats and Greens is referred to because of their party colours).
hypothesis: 工人们的情绪越来越愤怒。“带有革命幻想的呼吁正在流传，”哈贝克先生警告说。极右翼的德国选择党正在竭力煽动不满情绪。在德累斯顿，另一个极右翼组织“自由撒克逊人”渗透进了农民的抗议活动，呼吁“消灭红绿灯”（这是对由社会民主党、自由民主党和绿党组成的执政联盟的称呼，因为他们的政党颜色）。

source: Thomas Puls of IW Köln fears that the strikes will harm the image of Germany as a place for business. Local bosses are already fretting about a German version of the gilets jaunes protests in France in 2018, which culminated in yellow-jacketed demonstrators torching cars on the Champs-Elysées and the police stepping in with tear gas. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany's police union, warned in an interview with Tagesspiegel, a daily, that the farmers were probably "just the start of an enormous wave of protest this year." Germany was the only big economy to shrink in 2023, and the year ended on an especially sour note, with an unexpected drop in business confidence in December. This year is shaping up to be even tougher.
hypothesis: IW Köln的Thomas Puls担心罢工将损害德国作为商业场所的形象。当地老板们已经在担心德国会出现2018年法国“黄背心”抗议活动的翻版，那次抗议最终演变为身穿黄背心的示威者在香榭丽舍大街焚烧汽车，警察使用催泪瓦斯介入。德国警察工会负责人Jochen Kopelke在接受日报《每日镜报》采访时警告说，农民可能“只是今年巨大抗议浪潮的开始”。德国是2023年唯一萎缩的大型经济体，这一年以特别糟糕的基调结束，12月商业信心意外下降。今年可能会更加艰难。

source: Brewers froth over winemakers" exemption from anti-waste rules
hypothesis: 酿酒商对葡萄酒商豁免反浪费规则感到愤怒

source: As the EU debates rules to limit packaging waste, beer producers argue they are being unfairly discriminated against with exemptions for winemakers from reuse targets and deposit-return schemes, but one of Europe's wine industry association chiefs says brewers should "mind their own business."
hypothesis: 在欧盟就限制包装废弃物的规则进行辩论之际，啤酒生产商认为他们受到了不公平的歧视，因为葡萄酒商被豁免了再利用目标和押金返还计划，但欧洲葡萄酒行业协会的一位负责人表示，酿酒商应该“管好自己的事”。

source: European brewers have warned that exempting wine and not beer from deposit return schemes and reuse targets is unfair and potentially illegal, as lawmakers enter final talks over a new law designed to turn a surging tide of packaging waste across the EU.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商警告说，在押金返还计划和再利用目标上豁免葡萄酒而不豁免啤酒是不公平的，而且可能违法。目前，立法者正就一项旨在扭转欧盟各地包装废弃物激增趋势的新法律进行最后谈判。

source: Environment ministers agreed an EU Council negotiating mandate on the proposed Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) before Christmas, paving the way for imminent political talks with the European Parliament, which are already underway at the technical level.
hypothesis: 环境部长们在圣诞节前就拟议的《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）达成了欧盟理事会谈判授权，为即将与欧洲议会进行的政治谈判铺平了道路，这些谈判已在技术层面展开。

source: "Our position is clear," the trade association Brewers of Europe wrote to MEPs and government negotiators (10 January). "If targets and mandatory requirements in the PPWR apply to beer then there is a legal obligation that they apply to all alcoholic beverage categories."
hypothesis: “我们的立场很明确，”欧洲酿酒商行业协会在1月10日写给欧洲议会议员和政府谈判代表的信中说。“如果PPWR中的目标和强制性要求适用于啤酒，那么法律上就有义务将其适用于所有酒精饮料类别。”

source: The 18 December ministerial summit yielded a carve out for winemakers from the requirement that, by the end of the decade, 10% of products must be supplied in reusable containers within a system for reuse or refill, rising to 40% in 2040. The exemption would also apply to the requirement, likewise supported by the European Parliament, that wine should be exempt from deposit-return schemes that should be put in place by 2029 under the proposal.
hypothesis: 12月18日的部长级峰会为葡萄酒商争取到了豁免，使他们不必遵守到本十年末10%的产品必须在可重复使用或可再填充系统中以可重复使用容器供应的要求（该要求到2040年将提高到40%）。该豁免也适用于欧洲议会同样支持的要求，即根据该提案，葡萄酒应豁免于应在2029年前建立的押金返还计划。

source: Both the Czech and Belgian ministers immediately expressed reservations at the 18 December summit about the unequal treatment for brewers, but acquiesced. Belgium, which now chairs the rotating EU Council presidency and is therefore in principle neutral in terms of inter-governmental negotiations, hopes to clinch a deal with the parliament by early March.
hypothesis: 捷克和比利时部长在12月18日的峰会上立即对酿酒商受到的不平等待遇表示保留意见，但还是默许了。比利时目前担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国，因此原则上在政府间谈判中保持中立，希望在三月初与议会达成协议。

source: Ignacio Sánchez Recarte, secretary general of the Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins trade association representing some 7,000 wine producers across Europe, is dismissive of the concerns of the beer makers. He told Euronews that a market dominated by multinational brewing conglomerates bears no comparison with one comprised almost entirely of small, domestic producers.
hypothesis: 代表欧洲约7000家葡萄酒生产商的欧洲葡萄酒企业委员会行业协会秘书长Ignacio Sánchez Recarte对啤酒制造商的担忧不屑一顾。他告诉欧洲新闻台，一个由跨国酿酒集团主导的市场与一个几乎完全由小型国内生产商组成的市场无法相提并论。

source: More than 99% of the domestic wine sector is made up of micro- to medium-sized companies, Sánchez Recarte said, questioning the solidity of legal arguments made by brewers and asserting that his organisation had focused on presenting policy makers with information "relevant and appropriate" to its own industry.
hypothesis: Sánchez Recarte表示，国内葡萄酒行业99%以上由微型到中型企业组成，他质疑酿酒商提出的法律论据的可靠性，并断言他的组织一直专注于向政策制定者提供与其自身行业“相关且适当”的信息。

source: "It is not my role to estimate if the beer sector should have this or that target, as it would depend on the intrinsic characteristics of their own sector," Sánchez Recarte said. "In the same way, brewers should mind their own business and focus on their own responsibilities."
hypothesis: “评估啤酒行业是否应该有这样或那样的目标不是我的职责，因为这取决于他们自身行业的内在特征，”Sánchez Recarte说。“同样，酿酒商应该管好自己的事，专注于自己的责任。”

source: Brewers of Europe shared with Euronews a brief legal analysis it sent to the European Commission last year, where it argues that wine and beer are competing products that are "at least partially, substitutable with each other," and which argued that rules favouring one over the other would distort the market.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商协会与欧洲新闻台分享了一份去年发送给欧盟委员会的法律分析简报，其中辩称葡萄酒和啤酒是竞争产品，“至少在一定程度上可以相互替代”，并认为偏袒其中一种的规则会扭曲市场。

source: Simon Spillane, the lobby group's head of operations, said brewers were "already leading the way" in packaging sustainability, citing the example of beer kegs being reused around 165 times before being crushed and recycled after 30 years. They support reuse recycling systems already in place in many countries, he said.
hypothesis: 该游说团体的运营主管Simon Spillane表示，酿酒商在包装可持续性方面“已经领先”，他举例说，啤酒桶在30年后被压碎回收之前大约被重复使用165次。他说，他们支持许多国家已经建立的再利用回收系统。

source: "We therefore advocate for an ambitious PPWR but need a level playing field in packaging legislation where beer and other alcoholic beverages play by the same rules, with each sector contributing fairly to reaching the targets and supporting collection systems," Spillane told. "Any other approach puts the brewers at a competitive disadvantage."
hypothesis: “因此，我们主张制定一项雄心勃勃的PPWR，但需要在包装立法中有一个公平的竞争环境，让啤酒和其他酒精饮料遵守相同的规则，每个行业都公平地为实现目标和支持收集系统做出贡献，”Spillane说。“任何其他做法都会使酿酒商处于竞争劣势。”

source: The Biden Administration Is Letting Corporate Criminals Off the Hook
hypothesis: 拜登政府正在让企业罪犯逍遥法外

source: Tim Whitehouse, a former EPA enforcement attorney and the executive director of Public Employees for Environmental Responsibility, praised the Biden administration's recent improvements on enforcement while acknowledging the strong headwinds such efforts face. "It takes years of sustained funding and political support to build a good enforcement program," he told me. "The instability in Congress is not only demoralizing to EPA staff but undermines their ability to think strategically over the long term."
hypothesis: 前环保署执法律师、公职人员环境责任组织执行主任Tim Whitehouse赞扬了拜登政府近期在执法方面的改进，同时也承认这些努力面临强大的阻力。“建立一个良好的执法计划需要多年的持续资金和政治支持，”他告诉我。“国会的不稳定不仅让环保署工作人员士气低落，而且削弱了他们长期战略思考的能力。”

source: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.
hypothesis: 环保署的问题与司法部的问题虽有不同，但并非毫无关联。司法部通过其环境与自然资源部门（ENRD）处理环境犯罪。在加入环保署之前，环保署执法助理部长Uhlmann曾长期担任该部门环境犯罪科负责人，从1990年到2007年。环保署将其最严重的民事和刑事案件移交给ENRD，而ENRD作为一个资金相对不足的办公室，通常依赖其他机构帮助选择要处理的案件。在2022财年，环保署移交给司法部的案件（88件）比2000年以来的任何时候都少，结案的民事司法案件也比那时以来的任何时候都少。正如环境完整性项目所指出的，即使是特朗普时期的环保署，平均每年也结案94件民事案件，并向司法部移送106件案件。

source: The Department of Justice's overall approach to corporate crimes has come under intense scrutiny from advocates. While watchdogs have lauded some steps the department has taken during Merrick Garland's tenure as attorney general - like finally establishing a database on corporate crime - Biden's DOJ has also leaned heavily on leniency agreements that allow companies to defer or avoid prosecution, and encouraged companies to scapegoat individual employees so as to avoid a broader charge. Kenneth Polite Jr., former assistant attorney general for DOJ's Criminal Division, revised the division's corporate enforcement policy so as to limit prosecutions.
hypothesis: 司法部处理企业犯罪的整体做法受到了倡导者的密切关注。虽然监督机构赞扬了该部门在梅里克·加兰担任司法部长期间采取的一些措施——比如最终建立了企业犯罪数据库——但拜登政府的司法部也严重依赖允许企业推迟或避免起诉的宽大协议，并鼓励企业将个别员工作为替罪羊，以避免更广泛的指控。前司法部刑事司助理部长Kenneth Polite Jr.修订了该司的企业执法政策，以限制起诉。

source: Siso's depictions of land, water center new gallery exhibition
hypothesis: Siso对土地与水的描绘成为新画廊展览的核心

source: "People Swimming in the Swimming Pool" from 2022 is one Vicente Siso artwork that will display at Tierra del Sol Gallery beginning Jan. 13. (photo courtesy of Vicente Siso)
hypothesis: 2022年的《游泳池中游泳的人们》是Vicente Siso的一件艺术作品，将于1月13日起在Tierra del Sol画廊展出。（照片由Vicente Siso提供）

source: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. Siso has been an artist in the Studio Arts Program since 2012, this marks his debut solo exhibition. Siso was born 1962 in Madrid and raised between Venezuela, Trinidad and Miami; he moved with his family to Southern California in his early 20s.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol很高兴能在西好莱坞的新画廊地点呈现“Vicente Siso：土地与水的记忆”。Siso自2012年起一直是工作室艺术项目的艺术家，这标志着他首次举办个人展览。Siso于1962年出生在马德里，在委内瑞拉、特立尼达和迈阿密之间长大；他在二十出头时随家人搬到了南加州。

source: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.
hypothesis: Siso在题材上驾驭自如，创作了大量风景画、肖像画和静物作品，使用丙烯、粉彩、铅笔或水彩绘制。他借鉴家庭肖像、自己的参考照片和回忆，其色彩丰富的构图展示了他跨媒介的兴趣和技巧。Siso的热带风景和海景反映了他过去的地理环境，运用丰富的图案并融入人物，在文化、记忆和环境之间建立有意义的联系。Siso以西班牙语和英语混合的方式为作品命名，象征他在洛杉矶县生活中备受赞誉且不可或缺的复杂性。“Vicente Siso：土地与水的记忆”将于1月13日（星期六）开幕，招待会时间为下午6点至8点。展览将持续至3月3日（星期日）。

source: The Tierra del Sol Gallery is located at 7414 Santa Monica Blvd. For information, visit tierradelsolgallery.org.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol画廊位于圣莫尼卡大道7414号。如需了解更多信息，请访问tierradelsolgallery.org。

source: Adapt the old, accommodate the new to solve issue
hypothesis: 适应旧有，容纳新生，以解决问题

source: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.
hypothesis: 在区域层面，我们只需看看悉尼中央商务区，它已从定居前的景观发展成为一个两层楼的城市，从最高150英尺到如今高耸的塔楼。在规模小得多的层面上，同样的情况可以发生在悉尼交通节点周边的城镇中心。内城区也必须发展，转向在关键地点树冠高度以下提供更实惠的公寓生活。当然，新的住房增长需要精心设计，树木、景观和公园以及其他必要基础设施也需要纳入其中。

source: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. A way forward could be to have an independent decision-making body that championed quality design as long as it fitted below the tree tops and incorporated family living, large balconies, common gardens and presented a friendly appearance. This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.
hypothesis: 我们的规划系统也需要适应，以便郊区议会的规划者（他们似乎不太支持变革）不再是决定其郊区未来形态的唯一因素。一个前进的方向可能是设立一个独立的决策机构，只要设计符合树冠以下的高度，并包含家庭生活、大阳台、公共花园，且外观友好，就支持优质设计。这可能是新南威尔士州现任政府建筑师在精心制定的合规规范内发挥的作用。

source: Over the past decade, our lives have changed through technology, with many working from home, and Sydney has gained an impressive network of metro and light rail systems. Our ability to purchase online has changed the way we shop, and friends and family seem closer because of smartphone communication. All of these adaptations from one system to another can also occur in our built environment through a planning focus on adaptive reuse rather than preferencing heritage preservation.
hypothesis: 在过去十年中，科技改变了我们的生活，许多人居家办公，悉尼也拥有了令人印象深刻的地铁和轻轨系统网络。我们在线购物的能力改变了购物方式，而智能手机通讯让朋友和家人似乎更亲近了。所有这些从一个系统到另一个系统的适应，也可以通过规划重点放在适应性再利用而非偏好遗产保护上，在我们的建筑环境中实现。

source: Chris Johnson is a former NSW government architect (1995-2005) and executive director, NSW Department of Planning (2005-2009). He was CEO of Urban Taskforce Australia between 2011 and 2019.
hypothesis: Chris Johnson曾任新南威尔士州政府建筑师（1995-2005年）和新南威尔士州规划部执行主任（2005-2009年）。他在2011年至2019年间担任澳大利亚城市工作组首席执行官。

source: A final push for female equality
hypothesis: 为女性平等做最后冲刺

source: Last year, the World Economic Forum forecast that it would take five generations to achieve gender equality in every nation. Now the World Bank wants to rapidly accelerate that time frame.
hypothesis: 去年，世界经济论坛预测，要在每个国家实现性别平等需要五代人的时间。现在，世界银行希望大幅加快这一时间表。

source: The international financial institution is poised to launch a strategy aimed at significantly advancing the rights and economic opportunities for girls and women by 2030. The plan focuses on improving inclusivity and resilience through access to finance, technological innovation, and changes in public policy and law.
hypothesis: 这家国际金融机构准备推出一项战略，旨在到2030年大幅提升女孩和妇女的权利与经济机会。该计划侧重于通过获得金融服务、技术创新以及公共政策和法律变革来提高包容性和抗干扰能力。

source: "Recent research demonstrates that both social norms and mindsets can change, for example, that engaging men and boys can foster their support and buy-in for gender equality," a consultative draft of the plan states. "Positive gender outcomes can be accelerated and scaled with a better understanding of ... how social norms and mindsets shape everyday expectations, priorities, and practices."
hypothesis: 该计划的咨询草案指出：“最近的研究表明，社会规范和心态都可以改变，例如，让男性和男孩参与进来可以促进他们对性别平等的支持和认同。”“通过更好地理解……社会规范和心态如何塑造日常期望、优先事项和实践，可以加速并扩大积极的性别成果。”

source: Shifts in thought are harder to quantify than bank loans for rural women or school enrollment for girls. Yet there is plenty of evidence that female agency can move mountains. In Iran, for example, women have led the greatest threat to the Islamic government in 40 years simply by refusing to comply with laws that force them to cover their hair. In some of the 130 countries with minimum quotas for female representation in government, such as India, male resistance to female voting and political activism has eased.
hypothesis: 思想转变比农村妇女的银行贷款或女孩的入学率更难量化。然而，有大量证据表明，女性的能动性可以移山。例如，在伊朗，女性仅仅通过拒绝遵守强制她们遮盖头发的法律，就对伊斯兰政府构成了40年来最大的威胁。在130个对政府中女性代表设有最低配额的国家中，例如印度，男性对女性投票和政治活动的抵制已经有所缓解。

source: In some rural African communities, civil society organizations are replacing a harmful rite of passage with health education. One such program helped Kamanda Timayio, leader of the Masai village of Maparasha, Kenya, change his mind about female genital mutilation. He told Le Monde that he had "emerged from ignorance" and would abandon the practice.
hypothesis: 在一些非洲农村社区，民间社会组织正在用健康教育取代一种有害的成年礼。其中一个项目帮助肯尼亚马帕拉沙马赛村村长Kamanda Timayio改变了对女性生殖器切割的看法。他告诉《世界报》，他已经“摆脱了无知”，并将放弃这种做法。

source: The World Bank cites other examples. From 1970 to 2022, Bangladesh quadrupled female literacy rates and doubled female participation in the labor force. Its gross domestic product more than tripled. The change gathered its own momentum. Recruiting salaried women as teachers and health workers from within their own communities boosted trust "and made women's mobility and work more socially acceptable."
hypothesis: 世界银行还引用了其他例子。从1970年到2022年，孟加拉国的女性识字率翻了两番，女性劳动力参与率翻了一番。其国内生产总值增长了两倍多。这种变化自身也积累了动力。从社区内部招募有薪女性担任教师和卫生工作者，增强了信任，“并使女性的流动和工作更被社会接受”。

source: The bank's plan would target norms and institutions that may still require generational shifts. It has taken Rwanda more than two decades to establish itself as a model for land reforms that boost economic empowerment for women."No one benefits if women are held back," Rwanda President Paul Kagame said, arguing for land reform in 2015. "We have to change mindsets, not just the laws."
hypothesis: 该银行的计划将针对可能仍需要代际转变的规范和制度。卢旺达花了二十多年时间才将自己确立为促进妇女经济赋权的土地改革典范。卢旺达总统Paul Kagame在2015年主张土地改革时说：“如果女性受到阻碍，没有人会受益。”“我们必须改变心态，而不仅仅是法律。”

source: The World Bank hopes to spread that message.
hypothesis: 世界银行希望传播这一信息。

source: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses
hypothesis: 德国农民和火车司机正让德国老板们感到恐慌

source: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.
hypothesis: 在德国，工人和老板共同管理许多公司，大规模罢工并不常见。一波大规模罢工几乎闻所未闻。目前，这个“共同决定”的国家正同时面临愤怒农民为期八天的“行动周”（他们用拖拉机封锁道路）、铁路工人为期三天的罢工，以及最糟糕的是，医生即将举行的罢工（他们已经在圣诞节和元旦之间关闭了诊所）。一些人开始称之为“干草叉暴民”，这将在未来一年考验德国和谐的劳资关系。

source: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.
hypothesis: 抗议活动表面上是由政府决定终止农业用柴油补贴并取消农用车辆汽车税豁免引发的。这些措施让农民忍无可忍。这也动员了其他愤怒的工人，他们已经在通货膨胀、经济衰退和政府自我施加的紧缩压力下不堪重负。1月9日，国家铁路公司德国铁路的货运和客运列车司机因工作时间和薪酬开始罢工。

source: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.
hypothesis: 为了缓和与农民的紧张关系，政府同意在三年内逐步取消柴油补贴，并保留汽车税豁免。农民们对这些让步不屑一顾，认为不够。1月4日，一群激进的农民阻止了经济部长Robert Habeck在家庭度假归来时下渡轮。智库IW Köln认为，如果火车司机同样不买账，那可能会让德国企业付出高昂代价。铁路罢工如果迫使企业中断生产，每天可能造成1亿欧元（1.1亿美元）的损失。德国最大的汽车、化工和钢铁行业尤其依赖铁路运输。

source: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. The far-right Alternative for Germany party is doing its best to fan the grievances. In Dresden the Free Saxons, another far-right group, infiltrated the farmers" protest calling for the "extinction of the traffic light" (as the governing coalition of the Social Democrats, Free Democrats and Greens is referred to because of their party colours).
hypothesis: 工人们的情绪越来越愤怒。“带有革命幻想的呼吁正在流传，”Habeck先生警告说。极右翼的德国选择党正竭力煽动不满情绪。在德累斯顿，另一个极右翼组织“自由撒克逊人”渗透进了农民的抗议活动，呼吁“消灭红绿灯”（这是对由社会民主党、自由民主党和绿党组成的执政联盟的称呼，因为他们的政党颜色）。

source: Thomas Puls of IW Köln fears that the strikes will harm the image of Germany as a place for business. Local bosses are already fretting about a German version of the gilets jaunes protests in France in 2018, which culminated in yellow-jacketed demonstrators torching cars on the Champs-Elysées and the police stepping in with tear gas. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany's police union, warned in an interview with Tagesspiegel, a daily, that the farmers were probably "just the start of an enormous wave of protest this year." Germany was the only big economy to shrink in 2023, and the year ended on an especially sour note, with an unexpected drop in business confidence in December. This year is shaping up to be even tougher.
hypothesis: IW Köln的Thomas Puls担心罢工将损害德国作为商业场所的形象。当地老板们已经在担心德国会出现2018年法国“黄背心”抗议活动的翻版，那次抗议最终演变成身穿黄背心的示威者在香榭丽舍大街焚烧汽车，警察用催泪瓦斯介入。德国警察工会负责人Jochen Kopelke在接受日报《每日镜报》采访时警告说，农民可能“只是今年巨大抗议浪潮的开始”。德国是2023年唯一出现萎缩的大型经济体，这一年以特别糟糕的基调结束，12月商业信心意外下降。今年可能会更加艰难。

source: Brewers froth over winemakers" exemption from anti-waste rules
hypothesis: 酿酒商对葡萄酒商豁免反浪费规则感到愤怒

source: As the EU debates rules to limit packaging waste, beer producers argue they are being unfairly discriminated against with exemptions for winemakers from reuse targets and deposit-return schemes, but one of Europe's wine industry association chiefs says brewers should "mind their own business."
hypothesis: 在欧盟讨论限制包装废弃物的规则时，啤酒生产商认为他们受到了不公平的歧视，因为葡萄酒商被豁免了再利用目标和押金返还计划，但欧洲葡萄酒行业协会的一位负责人表示，酿酒商应该“管好自己的事”。

source: European brewers have warned that exempting wine and not beer from deposit return schemes and reuse targets is unfair and potentially illegal, as lawmakers enter final talks over a new law designed to turn a surging tide of packaging waste across the EU.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商警告说，在押金返还计划和再利用目标上豁免葡萄酒而不豁免啤酒是不公平的，而且可能违法，因为立法者正就一项旨在扭转欧盟各地包装废弃物激增趋势的新法律进行最后谈判。

source: Environment ministers agreed an EU Council negotiating mandate on the proposed Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) before Christmas, paving the way for imminent political talks with the European Parliament, which are already underway at the technical level.
hypothesis: 环境部长们在圣诞节前就拟议的《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）达成了欧盟理事会谈判授权，为即将与欧洲议会进行的政治谈判铺平了道路，这些谈判已在技术层面展开。

source: "Our position is clear," the trade association Brewers of Europe wrote to MEPs and government negotiators (10 January). "If targets and mandatory requirements in the PPWR apply to beer then there is a legal obligation that they apply to all alcoholic beverage categories."
hypothesis: “我们的立场很明确，”行业协会“欧洲酿酒商”在1月10日写给欧洲议会议员和政府谈判代表的信中说。“如果PPWR中的目标和强制性要求适用于啤酒，那么法律上就有义务适用于所有酒精饮料类别。”

source: The 18 December ministerial summit yielded a carve out for winemakers from the requirement that, by the end of the decade, 10% of products must be supplied in reusable containers within a system for reuse or refill, rising to 40% in 2040. The exemption would also apply to the requirement, likewise supported by the European Parliament, that wine should be exempt from deposit-return schemes that should be put in place by 2029 under the proposal.
hypothesis: 12月18日的部长级峰会为葡萄酒商争取到了豁免，免除了到本十年末10%的产品必须在可重复使用或再填充系统中以可重复使用容器供应的要求，该比例到2040年将升至40%。该豁免也适用于欧洲议会同样支持的要求，即根据提案，葡萄酒应豁免于应在2029年前实施的押金返还计划。

source: Both the Czech and Belgian ministers immediately expressed reservations at the 18 December summit about the unequal treatment for brewers, but acquiesced. Belgium, which now chairs the rotating EU Council presidency and is therefore in principle neutral in terms of inter-governmental negotiations, hopes to clinch a deal with the parliament by early March.
hypothesis: 捷克和比利时部长在12月18日的峰会上立即对酿酒商受到的不平等待遇表示保留意见，但默许了。比利时目前担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国，因此在政府间谈判中原则上保持中立，希望能在3月初与议会达成协议。

source: Ignacio Sánchez Recarte, secretary general of the Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins trade association representing some 7,000 wine producers across Europe, is dismissive of the concerns of the beer makers. He told Euronews that a market dominated by multinational brewing conglomerates bears no comparison with one comprised almost entirely of small, domestic producers.
hypothesis: 代表欧洲约7000家葡萄酒生产商的行业协会Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins秘书长Ignacio Sánchez Recarte对啤酒制造商的担忧不屑一顾。他告诉欧洲新闻台，一个由跨国酿造集团主导的市场与一个几乎完全由小型国内生产商组成的市场无法相提并论。

source: More than 99% of the domestic wine sector is made up of micro- to medium-sized companies, Sánchez Recarte said, questioning the solidity of legal arguments made by brewers and asserting that his organisation had focused on presenting policy makers with information "relevant and appropriate" to its own industry.
hypothesis: Sánchez Recarte表示，国内葡萄酒行业99%以上由微型到中型企业组成，他质疑酿酒商法律论据的可靠性，并声称他的组织一直专注于向政策制定者提供与其行业“相关且适当”的信息。

source: "It is not my role to estimate if the beer sector should have this or that target, as it would depend on the intrinsic characteristics of their own sector," Sánchez Recarte said. "In the same way, brewers should mind their own business and focus on their own responsibilities."
hypothesis: “评估啤酒行业是否应该有这个或那个目标不是我的职责，因为这取决于他们自身行业的内在特征，”Sánchez Recarte说。“同样，酿酒商应该管好自己的事，专注于自己的责任。”

source: Brewers of Europe shared with Euronews a brief legal analysis it sent to the European Commission last year, where it argues that wine and beer are competing products that are "at least partially, substitutable with each other," and which argued that rules favouring one over the other would distort the market.
hypothesis: 欧洲酿酒商与欧洲新闻台分享了一份去年发送给欧盟委员会的法律分析简报，其中辩称葡萄酒和啤酒是竞争产品，“至少在一定程度上可以相互替代”，并认为偏袒其中一种的规则会扭曲市场。

source: Simon Spillane, the lobby group's head of operations, said brewers were "already leading the way" in packaging sustainability, citing the example of beer kegs being reused around 165 times before being crushed and recycled after 30 years. They support reuse recycling systems already in place in many countries, he said.
hypothesis: 游说团体运营负责人Simon Spillane表示，酿酒商在包装可持续性方面“已经领先”，他举例说啤酒桶在30年后被压碎回收之前大约被重复使用165次。他说，他们支持许多国家已经实施的再利用回收系统。

source: "We therefore advocate for an ambitious PPWR but need a level playing field in packaging legislation where beer and other alcoholic beverages play by the same rules, with each sector contributing fairly to reaching the targets and supporting collection systems," Spillane told. "Any other approach puts the brewers at a competitive disadvantage."
hypothesis: “因此，我们倡导一项雄心勃勃的PPWR，但需要在包装立法中有一个公平的竞争环境，让啤酒和其他酒精饮料遵循相同的规则，每个行业公平地为实现目标和支持收集系统做出贡献，”Spillane说。“任何其他做法都会使酿酒商处于竞争劣势。”

source: The Biden Administration Is Letting Corporate Criminals Off the Hook
hypothesis: 拜登政府正在让企业罪犯逍遥法外

source: Tim Whitehouse, a former EPA enforcement attorney and the executive director of Public Employees for Environmental Responsibility, praised the Biden administration's recent improvements on enforcement while acknowledging the strong headwinds such efforts face. "It takes years of sustained funding and political support to build a good enforcement program," he told me. "The instability in Congress is not only demoralizing to EPA staff but undermines their ability to think strategically over the long term."
hypothesis: 前环保署执法律师、公职人员环境责任组织执行主任Tim Whitehouse称赞了拜登政府近期在执法方面的改进，同时承认这些努力面临强大的阻力。“建立一个良好的执法计划需要多年的持续资金和政治支持，”他告诉我。“国会的不稳定不仅让环保署工作人员士气低落，而且削弱了他们长期战略思考的能力。”

source: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.
hypothesis: 环保署的问题与司法部的问题不同，但并非无关。司法部通过其环境与自然资源部门（ENRD）处理环境犯罪。在加入环保署之前，环保署执法助理部长Uhlmann曾长期担任该部门环境犯罪科负责人，从1990年到2007年。环保署将其最严重的民事和刑事案件提交给ENRD，而ENRD作为一个资金相对不足的办公室，通常依赖其他机构帮助选择要处理的案件。在2022财年，环保署移交给司法部的案件（88件）比2000年以来的任何时候都少，结案的民事司法案件也比那时以来的任何时候都少。正如环境完整性项目所指出的，即使是特朗普时期的环保署，平均每年也结案94件民事案件，并向司法部移交106件案件。

source: The Department of Justice's overall approach to corporate crimes has come under intense scrutiny from advocates. While watchdogs have lauded some steps the department has taken during Merrick Garland's tenure as attorney general - like finally establishing a database on corporate crime - Biden's DOJ has also leaned heavily on leniency agreements that allow companies to defer or avoid prosecution, and encouraged companies to scapegoat individual employees so as to avoid a broader charge. Kenneth Polite Jr., former assistant attorney general for DOJ's Criminal Division, revised the division's corporate enforcement policy so as to limit prosecutions.
hypothesis: 司法部对企业犯罪的整体做法受到了倡导者的密切关注。虽然监督机构赞扬了该部门在Merrick Garland担任司法部长期间采取的一些措施——比如最终建立了企业犯罪数据库——但拜登政府的司法部也严重依赖允许公司推迟或避免起诉的宽大协议，并鼓励公司让个别员工当替罪羊，以避免更广泛的指控。前司法部刑事部门助理部长Kenneth Polite Jr.修订了该部门的企业执法政策，以限制起诉。

source: Siso's depictions of land, water center new gallery exhibition
hypothesis: 西索的陆地与水域描绘成为新画廊展览的核心

source: "People Swimming in the Swimming Pool" from 2022 is one Vicente Siso artwork that will display at Tierra del Sol Gallery beginning Jan. 13. (photo courtesy of Vicente Siso)
hypothesis: 2022年的《泳池中的人们》是维森特·西索的一件作品，将于1月13日起在Tierra del Sol画廊展出。（图片由维森特·西索提供）

source: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. Siso has been an artist in the Studio Arts Program since 2012, this marks his debut solo exhibition. Siso was born 1962 in Madrid and raised between Venezuela, Trinidad and Miami; he moved with his family to Southern California in his early 20s.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol画廊荣幸地在西好莱坞的新址呈现“维森特·西索：陆地与水域的记忆”。西索自2012年起成为工作室艺术项目的艺术家，此次展览是他的首次个展。西索1962年出生于马德里，在委内瑞拉、特立尼达和迈阿密之间长大；二十出头时随家人移居南加州。

source: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.
hypothesis: 西索在题材上游刃有余，创作了大量风景画、肖像画和静物作品，媒介涵盖丙烯、粉彩、铅笔和水彩。他从家庭肖像、自己拍摄的参考照片和回忆中汲取灵感，色彩丰富的构图展现了他广泛的兴趣和跨媒介的技艺。西索的热带风景和海景反映了他过往的地理记忆，运用丰富的图案并融入人物，在文化、记忆与环境之间建立有意义的联系。西索以西班牙语和英语混合的方式为作品命名，体现了他生活在洛杉矶县所经历的复杂而珍贵的生命历程。“维森特·西索：陆地与水域的记忆”将于1月13日（周六）开幕，招待会时间为下午6点至8点。展览将持续至3月3日（周日）。

source: The Tierra del Sol Gallery is located at 7414 Santa Monica Blvd. For information, visit tierradelsolgallery.org.
hypothesis: Tierra del Sol画廊位于圣莫尼卡大道7414号。欲了解更多信息，请访问tierradelsolgallery.org。

source: Adapt the old, accommodate the new to solve issue
hypothesis: 改造旧建筑、容纳新需求以解决问题

source: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.
hypothesis: 在区域层面，我们只需看看悉尼中央商务区这个例子：它从一片未开发的土地发展成一座两层楼的城市，从最高150英尺的建筑到如今高耸入云的塔楼。在规模小得多的层面上，悉尼各交通枢纽周边的城镇中心也可以实现同样的发展。内城区也必须演变，在关键地块上转向树冠高度以下的更实惠的公寓生活。当然，新增住房需要精心设计，树木、景观和公园以及其他必要的基础设施也必须纳入其中。

source: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. A way forward could be to have an independent decision-making body that championed quality design as long as it fitted below the tree tops and incorporated family living, large balconies, common gardens and presented a friendly appearance. This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.
hypothesis: 我们的规划体系也需要调整，以免郊区议会的规划者——他们似乎不太支持变革——成为决定郊区未来形态的唯一力量。一个可行的方向是设立一个独立的决策机构，只要设计符合树冠高度以下的要求，并包含家庭居住空间、大阳台、公共花园，且外观友好，就予以支持。这可以由现任新南威尔士州政府建筑师在精心制定的合规规范框架内承担。

source: Over the past decade, our lives have changed through technology, with many working from home, and Sydney has gained an impressive network of metro and light rail systems. Our ability to purchase online has changed the way we shop, and friends and family seem closer because of smartphone communication. All of these adaptations from one system to another can also occur in our built environment through a planning focus on adaptive reuse rather than preferencing heritage preservation.
hypothesis: 过去十年，科技改变了我们的生活，许多人居家办公，悉尼也建成了令人瞩目的地铁和轻轨网络。在线购物的能力改变了我们的购物方式，智能手机通讯让朋友和家人似乎更亲近了。所有这些从一个系统到另一个系统的适应，同样可以发生在我们的建筑环境中，只要规划的重点是适应性再利用，而不是一味偏好遗产保护。

source: Chris Johnson is a former NSW government architect (1995-2005) and executive director, NSW Department of Planning (2005-2009). He was CEO of Urban Taskforce Australia between 2011 and 2019.
hypothesis: 克里斯·约翰逊曾任新南威尔士州政府建筑师（1995-2005年）和新南威尔士州规划部执行主任（2005-2009年）。他于2011年至2019年担任澳大利亚城市工作组首席执行官。

source: A final push for female equality
hypothesis: 为女性平等做最后的推动

source: Last year, the World Economic Forum forecast that it would take five generations to achieve gender equality in every nation. Now the World Bank wants to rapidly accelerate that time frame.
hypothesis: 去年，世界经济论坛预测，要在所有国家实现性别平等需要五代人的时间。如今，世界银行希望大幅加快这一进程。

source: The international financial institution is poised to launch a strategy aimed at significantly advancing the rights and economic opportunities for girls and women by 2030. The plan focuses on improving inclusivity and resilience through access to finance, technological innovation, and changes in public policy and law.
hypothesis: 这家国际金融机构即将推出一项战略，旨在到2030年显著提升女孩和妇女的权利与经济机会。该计划侧重于通过金融服务获取、技术创新以及公共政策和法律的变革来提高包容性和韧性。

source: "Recent research demonstrates that both social norms and mindsets can change, for example, that engaging men and boys can foster their support and buy-in for gender equality," a consultative draft of the plan states. "Positive gender outcomes can be accelerated and scaled with a better understanding of ... how social norms and mindsets shape everyday expectations, priorities, and practices."
hypothesis: “近期研究表明，社会规范和心态都是可以改变的，例如，让男性和男孩参与进来可以促进他们对性别平等的支持和认同，”该计划的一份咨询草案指出。“如果能更好地理解……社会规范和心态如何塑造日常的期望、优先事项和实践，就可以加速并扩大积极的性别成果。”

source: Shifts in thought are harder to quantify than bank loans for rural women or school enrollment for girls. Yet there is plenty of evidence that female agency can move mountains. In Iran, for example, women have led the greatest threat to the Islamic government in 40 years simply by refusing to comply with laws that force them to cover their hair. In some of the 130 countries with minimum quotas for female representation in government, such as India, male resistance to female voting and political activism has eased.
hypothesis: 思想观念的转变比农村妇女的银行贷款或女童入学率更难量化。然而，有大量证据表明，女性的能动性可以移山倒海。例如，在伊朗，女性仅仅通过拒绝遵守强制她们遮盖头发的法律，就对伊斯兰政府构成了40年来最大的威胁。在130个对政府中女性代表比例设有最低配额的国家中，以印度为例，男性对女性投票和政治参与的抵制已经有所缓解。

source: In some rural African communities, civil society organizations are replacing a harmful rite of passage with health education. One such program helped Kamanda Timayio, leader of the Masai village of Maparasha, Kenya, change his mind about female genital mutilation. He told Le Monde that he had "emerged from ignorance" and would abandon the practice.
hypothesis: 在一些非洲农村社区，民间社会组织正在用健康教育取代一种有害的成年礼。其中一个项目帮助肯尼亚马帕拉沙马赛村村长卡曼达·蒂马约改变了对女性生殖器切割的看法。他告诉《世界报》，他已经“摆脱了无知”，将放弃这一做法。

source: The World Bank cites other examples. From 1970 to 2022, Bangladesh quadrupled female literacy rates and doubled female participation in the labor force. Its gross domestic product more than tripled. The change gathered its own momentum. Recruiting salaried women as teachers and health workers from within their own communities boosted trust "and made women's mobility and work more socially acceptable."
hypothesis: 世界银行还引用了其他例子。从1970年到2022年，孟加拉国的女性识字率翻了两番，女性劳动力参与率翻了一番。其国内生产总值增长了两倍多。这种变化形成了自身的势头。从社区内部招募有薪女性担任教师和卫生工作者，增强了信任，“也让女性的出行和工作更容易被社会接受”。

source: The bank's plan would target norms and institutions that may still require generational shifts. It has taken Rwanda more than two decades to establish itself as a model for land reforms that boost economic empowerment for women."No one benefits if women are held back," Rwanda President Paul Kagame said, arguing for land reform in 2015. "We have to change mindsets, not just the laws."
hypothesis: 该银行的计划将针对可能仍需要代际转变的规范和制度。卢旺达花了二十多年时间才将自己打造成通过土地改革增强女性经济赋权的典范。“如果女性受到阻碍，没有人会受益，”卢旺达总统保罗·卡加梅在2015年为土地改革辩护时说。“我们必须改变心态，而不仅仅是法律。”

source: The World Bank hopes to spread that message.
hypothesis: 世界银行希望传播这一信息。

source: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses
hypothesis: 德国农民和火车司机让德国老板们感到恐慌

source: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.
hypothesis: 在德国，工人和老板共同管理许多公司，大规模罢工并不常见。一波大规模罢工更是闻所未闻。如今，这个“共同决定”的国家正同时面临愤怒农民的八天“行动周”——他们用拖拉机封锁道路、铁路工人的三天罢工，以及最糟糕的是，医生们即将举行的罢工——他们已经在圣诞节到元旦期间关闭了诊所。一些人开始称这场运动为“干草叉暴民”（Mistgabelmop），它将在未来一年考验德国和谐的劳资关系。
